jobs.title: Junior Software Developer
jobs.description:
Wil jij bouwen aan software die dagelijks door honderden organisaties wordt gebruikt?

Als Junior Software Developer bij Tools4ever werk je mee aan HelloID, onze Identity & Access Management-cloudsoftware. Je komt terecht in een team waar je kunt leren van ervaren developers en waar je stap voor stap meer verantwoordelijkheid krijgt. Je werkt aan echte software die door veel organisaties wordt gebruikt. Daarbij denk je mee over slimme oplossingen, los je technische puzzels op en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen. Zo groei je in je rol, zonder dat je alles al hoeft te weten.

Bij Tools4ever werk je in een omgeving waar duidelijkheid, kwaliteit en samenwerking belangrijk zijn. Je krijgt heldere doelen en weet wat er van je wordt verwacht. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en je eigen keuzes goed te onderbouwen. Je denkt mee over praktische oplossingen, schrijft nette en onderhoudbare code en leert steeds beter hoe je software bouwt die betrouwbaar is in de praktijk.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar staat er niet alleen voor: je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s en kunt vragen stellen wanneer dat nodig is. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf verder, terwijl je vanaf het begin echt meedraait in het team.

Wat ga je doen?

In je gestructureerde en zelfsturende team ontwikkel je hoogwaardige cloud software namelijk HelloID. Onze SaaS cloud oplossing HelloID is voor veel bedrijven dé oplossing op hun Identity Management vraagstukken. Samen zorgen de teams ervoor dat er software wordt geleverd waar onze klanten met plezier mee werken; wat altijd in de lucht is en wat veilig is.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van hoogwaardige C# .NET cloudsoftware
Werken als junior developer binnen een moderne SaaS-architectuur
Schrijven van schone, onderhoudbare en goed geteste code
Nauwkeurig inschatten van de werklast in een stand up meeting elke ochtend
Leren over cloud based webapplicaties

Je weet wanneer je hulp en advies nodig hebt en biedt dit ook aan anderen. Na elke sprint lever je de software op (DevOps) en kun je zelfstandig releases beheren. Je draagt bij aan de sprint review (demo) voor de stakeholders. Voor meer inzicht in de werkzaamheden van onze softwareontwikkelaars, lees dan hier onze roadmap: roadmap.helloid.com.

Onze tech-stack

Talen: C#, TypeScript

Frameworks: .NET (Core), Angular

Cloud & infrastructuur: Google Cloud, Azure, Kubernetes

Databases: MongoDB, SQL

Tools & methodieken: Visual Studio, Git, DevOps, Agile/Scrum

Wie zijn wij?

Bij Tools4ever draait alles om slimme oplossingen, teamwork en plezier. Met meer dan 800 actieve klanten is Tools4ever marktleider in Nederland op het gebied van Identity Governance & Administration. Onze oplossingen worden gebruikt door organisaties van 200 tot 30.000 medewerkers in alle sectoren, zoals de zorg, detailhandel, (semi)overheid en commerciële sectoren. Onze klanten zijn onder andere de gemeente Amsterdam, Revant, Naturalis en Codarts.

Maar die sfeer proef je ook op ons kantoor in Baarn: we lunchen samen, organiseren regelmatig leuke uitjes (minstens één per kwartaal), bieden verschillende sportieve activiteiten aan en doen in de zomer én winter iets gezelligs met elkaar, zoals samen skiën. Bij Tools4ever krijg je vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid in een gedreven en pragmatische cultuur. We kijken altijd naar de impact op onze belangrijkste drijfveren: medewerkerstevredenheid en klanttevredenheid.

We ontwikkelen ons product volledig in eigen beheer, zonder externe investeerders. Dat geeft rust, focus en ruimte voor kwaliteit en innovatie. Software development is bij ons geen ondersteunende afdeling, maar het hart van de organisatie.

Jouw team

Onze developers zijn verdeeld in drie gestructureerde teams: één Service Automation-team en twee Provisioning-teams, elk bestaande uit ongeveer zes collega’s. Daarnaast zijn er twee Product Owners die betrokken zijn bij alle drie de teams.

Onze Developers voeren gemiddeld 1-2 taken per dag uit, afhankelijk van de complexiteit van de taak. Deze taken worden gezamenlijk en nauwkeurig besproken tijdens de dagelijkse stand-up meeting. In deze teams zijn zelfstandigheid, pragmatisme en samenwerking essentieel. Samen zorgen we ervoor dat ons product HelloID efficiënt en optimaal functioneert.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt al wat ervaring als developer en wilt je verder ontwikkelen. Je werkt zelfstandig aan je taken, neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk en denkt praktisch mee. Ook werk je nauwkeurig en draag je graag bij aan een team waar samenwerking en kwaliteit belangrijk zijn.

Daarnaast Beschik Je Over

Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding
Minimaal één jaar werkervaring als Developer, buiten stages om
Het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken, met de ondersteuning van je team wanneer dat nodig is

Het sollicitatieproces

Wij streven ernaar om binnen 48 uur na jouw sollicitatie contact met je op te nemen. Komt jouw profiel in aanmerking en word je uitgenodigd voor een gesprek streven wij dit binnen 3 weken af te handelen.

Betrouwbaarheid en integriteit zijn voor ons essentieel. Daarom vragen wij voor deze functie een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).

jobs.title: Principal Product Software Engineer
jobs.description:
R0055254 - Principal Product Software Engineer

Wolters Kluwer

Wolters Kluwer delivers expert solutions that combine deep domain knowledge with advanced technology, enabling professionals to make better decisions, stay compliant with complex regulations, and improve outcomes. Its portfolio spans industries such as Health, Tax & Accounting, Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), and Legal & Regulatory. Innovation, digital transformation, and responsible business practices are core to Wolters Kluwer’s long-term strategy.

Twinfield
, part of Wolters Kluwer, is a cloud‑based accounting software solution designed for businesses and accounting professionals. It streamlines financial administration by automating bookkeeping, invoicing, cash flow management, and reporting in real time. Twinfield is known for its strong compliance capabilities, security, and integration options, making it well suited for SMEs, international organizations, and accounting firms. You will be part of the ‘Tech B.V.’
team, which focuses on development, service and delivery of technology solutions that support Twinfield’s digital products and services.

Why this role exists

We’re looking for a Principal Engineer who makes engineering teams meaningfully better.

Not by introducing the newest framework or rewriting everything, but by improving how problems are understood, how systems are designed, and how value moves from idea to production. You’ve helped organizations ship faster and with higher quality by changing engineering practices, not just codebases.

This role is for someone who operates at the intersection of architecture, engineering effectiveness, and modern AI-enabled development, with a strong bias toward rigor, clarity, and measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Own the hard problems

Take loosely defined product or platform problems and turn them into clear problem statements, constraints, and success criteria.
Rationalize complex technical architectures into coherent, reviewable designs that engineers can execute incrementally.
Make principled tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long term maintainability—and explain those tradeoffs clearly.

Raise the bar on engineering practices

Identify friction in the SDLC and help teams remove it through better design practices, clearer specifications, improved testing strategies, and tighter feedback loops.
Lead the adoption of specification driven development: explicit contracts, well-defined interfaces, and testable requirements.
Promote development workflows where design, validation, and implementation are deliberate phases, and production code reflects understood decisions.

Accelerate delivery (measurably)

Help teams deliver faster by improving how work is shaped, not by asking people to work harder.
Introduce practices that lead to observable improvements in:
Lead time and cycle time
Change failure rate
Defect escape rates
Confidence in releases
Use data where it helps, judgment where it matters.

Enable agentic development—responsibly

Experiment with and enable agentic development techniques across the SDLC, including requirements refinement, design exploration, test generation and validation, documentation, and maintenance.
Ensure that AI and agent assisted development is grounded in explicit intent—using specifications, contracts, and tests as primary inputs—so automation amplifies engineering judgment rather than substituting for it.
Establish guardrails that keep systems understandable, changes reviewable, and intent preserved over time.

Build and evolve cloud-native systems (modernization, not just migration)

Lead and contribute to the design and delivery of cloud-native applications: observable, resilient, secure by default, and independently deployable.
Guide teams through legacy modernization efforts that result in true cloud-native characteristics—clear service boundaries, independent deployability, container readiness, and appropriate use of managed platform services—not simply moving existing systems to cloud infrastructure.
Help teams make pragmatic hosting decisions (IaaS vs. PaaS, VMs vs. containers/Kubernetes) based on system constraints, maturity, and desired outcomes.

Build API first systems across protocols

Design, build, and evolve APIs with strong contract discipline, backward compatibility strategies, and a focus on consumer experience.
Bring broad experience consuming and producing multiple API styles and protocols, including:
SOAP / WCFstyle services
RESTful APIs (including hypermedia / HATEOAS where appropriate)
gRPC
Understand and articulate the tradeoffs between these approaches—latency, coupling, discoverability, versioning, tooling, and evolution—and guide teams on when each is appropriate.

Build AI powered products (not demos)

Contribute to systems that integrate AI/ML capabilities into real, customer facing products, including (but not limited to) GenAI features and agents.
Help teams reason about model behavior, failure modes, system boundaries, and operational risks.
Ensure AI features are built with security, observability, and long term operability in mind.

Lead without authority

Act as a technical multiplier across teams.
Mentor senior and staff engineers through design reviews, architectural discussions, and hands-on collaboration.
Influence through clarity, reasoning, and credibility—not mandates.

Our technical context (for orientation, not gatekeeping)

Our systems span a mix of:

Backend technologies including Microsoft .NET (multiple versions and languages).
Frontend technologies such as JavaScript / TypeScript with frameworks like Angular and React.
Infrastructure across both IaaS and PaaS, including virtual machines and Kubernetes based platforms, all hosted on Microsoft Azure.

You do not need to have worked with all of these specifically. Experience with similar ecosystems and the ability to reason across them matters more than matching keywords.

How You Work

We’re looking for someone who:

Thinks in systems, but delivers in increments.
Writes design documents that engineers actually want to read.
Treats testing, documentation, and observability as first-class engineering concerns.
Is comfortable saying “this is good enough for now” and “this needs to be fixed properly.”
Knows when to experiment and when to standardize.

Experience We Care About (not Checkboxes)

We care less about which technologies you’ve used and more about what changed because you were there. Strong signals include:

Leading or heavily influencing architectural decisions in complex systems.
Improving engineering throughput and quality through better practices—not rewrites.
Leading modernization efforts that moved systems toward genuine cloud-native outcomes.
Enabling AI assisted and agentic workflows with clear intent, specifications, and guardrails.
Demonstrated breadth across API styles and the judgment to choose and evolve them appropriately.

What Success Looks Like

After you’ve been here for a while:

Teams are clearer on what they’re building and why before they start coding.
Delivery is faster, releases are calmer, and failures are easier to reason about.
Engineers trust the systems they work on—and the process they use to change them.
AI and agents are used where they create leverage, with intent preserved and outcomes measurable.

What do we offer?

A 36- to 40-hours working week with flexible working hours and the possibility to work from home.
A salary fitting your skill level.
25 vacation days (based of 40 hours).
A hybrid way of working, max 2 days at the office per week.
Wolters Kluwer refunds 50% of your pension contributions.
An informal working environment and with multiple events planned each year.
Coffee from freshly toasted fair-trade beans and every day delicious fresh fruit.
Every day a lunch buffet is provided to enjoy with your colleagues and free of cost.

Apply

If you are a motivated individual with and you like what you see in this job description, we would love to hear from you. Simply by clicking on the apply button!

Contact

Marijke van Liempt - Senior Corporate Recruiter

Email: Marijke.vanLiempt@wolterskluwer.com

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Java/C#)
jobs.description:
Introduction to the job

Are you energized by solving complex engineering challenges in a multidisciplinary team? Do you enjoy applying modern software engineering practices to create solutions that make a difference for customers?

Would you like to contribute to advanced metrology systems and help improve equipment throughput, automation, and integration with customer manufacturing environments?

If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you as a Software Engineer
.

Role and responsibilities

As a Software Engineer, you will develop software for complex machine and algorithm-based solutions. You will take end-to-end ownership of software development in Java and/or C#
, directly contributing to the evolution of metrology solutions.

You will join a team that develops automated data-analysis workflows to improve the performance of advanced metrology systems. Your work will focus on implementing sophisticated machine and algorithm functionality.

You will work closely with software engineers and multidisciplinary stakeholders to deliver high-quality, production-ready functionality. You will also collaborate with Customer Support and Manufacturing teams to ensure smooth integration and practical usability.

Your responsibilities will cover the full software development lifecycle, including:

Refining requirements and user stories
Designing software solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs
Planning and estimating development work
Defining and executing test strategies
Developing and maintaining software
Supporting CI/CD pipelines
Troubleshooting technical issues
Preparing software releases
Communicating progress and technical decisions

You will demonstrate strong Java and/or C# engineering practices and contribute to team discussions and design decisions.

Main responsibilities

Take end-to-end ownership of feature and story-based software development, from refinement through delivery.
Align specifications with relevant stakeholders to establish shared understanding and technical consistency.
Safeguard software and product quality through robust engineering practices and peer reviews.
Deliver high-quality software through disciplined design, thorough testing, and clear, maintainable documentation.
Share technical knowledge with colleagues and customer-facing teams to support successful integration and operation.

Education and experience

A master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, informatics, or a related technical field.
At least five years of professional experience developing technical, object-oriented software solutions using Java and/or C#.
Experience working in a high-tech, algorithm-driven, or complex systems environment is preferred.
Strong knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to create robust, scalable, and maintainable software.
Practical experience with Test-Driven Development and automated testing.
Strong mathematical and analytical skills, with the ability to translate advanced algorithms into production-ready software.
Experience with image processing or numerical algorithms is preferred.
Experience with Python or React is an advantage.
Willingness to work with different technologies, including Java, C#, Python, and React, depending on project needs.
Experience with large-scale data processing, data-storage design, or query-performance optimization is an advantage.

Skills

To thrive in this role, you:

Work effectively as part of a collaborative and multidisciplinary team.
Are comfortable in a dynamic, high-tech product-development environment.
Combine strong analytical thinking with a pragmatic and flexible approach to problem-solving.
Take ownership and remain accountable for results.
Focus on business and customer value and prioritize work effectively.
Are curious, learn quickly, and apply new knowledge effectively.
Communicate clearly and confidently in written and spoken English.

Other information

ASML is a leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, enabling the production of integrated circuits and microchips. Our software engineers play an important role in optimizing semiconductor manufacturing processes and improving quality and efficiency.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of advanced metrology solutions that help customers improve process control, accelerate production ramp-up, and optimize output.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.

730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Inclusion and diversity

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

jobs.description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat integratieoplossingen in Azure Integration Services ontwikkelen, beheren en optimaliseren, koppelingen met Dynamics 365 realiseren, data-uitwisseling verbeteren en als sparringpartner technische keuzes en duurzame oplossingen vormgeven binnen een scrumteam.

Opdrachtomschrijving

Je ontwikkelt, beheert en optimaliseert oplossingen binnen Azure Integration Services. Daarnaast realiseer en onderhoud je koppelingen tussen Dataverse, Dynamics 365 en andere applicaties met behulp van C#/.NET.

Je analyseert requirements en vertaalt deze naar technische oplossingen. Ook ondersteun je bij vraagstukken rondom gegevensuitwisseling en integraties binnen het applicatielandschap. Je signaleert kansen voor automatisering en realiseert deze waar mogelijk.

Verder stel je technische documentatie op en werk je nauw samen met de product owner, businessanalisten en toezichthouders binnen het team. Daarnaast ben je een volwaardige sparringpartner voor toezichthouders, architecten, beheerders en ontwikkelaars, zowel binnen als buiten het scrumteam.

Achtergrond opdracht

Voor de doorontwikkeling en borging van master- en referentiedata binnen de AFM zijn wij op zoek naar een Senior Developer. Je werkt binnen een multidisciplinair scrumteam dat zich inzet voor betrouwbare en kwalitatief hoogwaardige data. Het doel is dat toezichthouders, marktpartijen en consumenten kunnen vertrouwen op de data van de AFM. In deze rol ontwikkel, beheer en verbeter je binnen Azure Integration Services met integratie naar Dynamics 365. Je denkt actief mee over technische keuzes en vertaalt functionele wensen naar duurzame, toekomstbestendige oplossingen.

Formaat: Word
Taal: Nederlands
Max. aantal pagina's: geen max
Motivatie: Verplicht
Additionele eisen: Uren per week

Keten (lev-HFG-AFM)
Senior ontwikkelaar (C#, .NET, SQL) met minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring
Uitgebreide kennis en ervaring met Azure Integration Services met integratie naar Dynamics 365
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands

Kennis van Power Platform met focus op Dataverse en Power Automate
Kennis van datamodellering en metadatamanagement
Sparringpartner voor business, architecten en teams
Aantoonbare ervaring met en enthousiasme voor samenwerken binnen een multidisciplinair scrumteam
Kandidaten dienen te beschikken over basiskennis van privacywetgeving (AVG), verantwoord gebruik van AI (zoals Copilot) en informatie- en databeveiliging, voor zover dit relevant is voor de rol.

Overige informatie

Over de opdrachtgever

De Autoriteit Financiële Markten (AFM) is een onafhankelijke gedragstoezichthouder op de financiële markten in Nederland. De AFM houdt toezicht op de financiële sector en ziet erop toe dat deze sector eerlijk en transparant functioneert. De organisatie heeft als doel om consumenten en bedrijven te beschermen en het vertrouwen in de financiële markten te waarborgen. De AFM controleert of financiële instellingen en marktpartijen zich houden aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving en grijpt in wanneer er sprake is van misstanden of overtredingen.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Over de functie

In het kort: Je gaat softwareoplossingen ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en automatiseren, nauw samenwerken met diverse stakeholders, legacy-systemen verbeteren en actief bijdragen aan productkwaliteit, innovatie en continue verbetering binnen een complexe IT-omgeving.

Let op, deze opdracht betreft een verambtelijking!

Opdrachtbeschrijving

IBS Loonheffingen is op zoek naar een software engineer die meer wil dan alleen code schrijven en verder kijkt dan alleen technische testcases. Iemand die verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen voor het product en de kwaliteit ervan, actief meedenkt over verbeteringen, risico’s durft te benoemen en goed aanvoelt wat de gebruiker en het team nodig hebben.

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van softwareoplossingen
Vertalen van functionele eisen naar technische oplossingen
Schrijven van efficiënte, onderhoudbare en schaalbare code
Werken met programmeertalen, frameworks en tools passend bij het project (zoals Java, Python, .NET, enz.)
Testen en kwaliteitsborging
Opstellen en uitvoeren van testplannen, testscenario’s en automatische tests (Java)
Meedenken over requirements en user stories vanuit een kwaliteitsbril
Uitvoeren van regressie-, integratie-, functionele- en performance testen en betrokken bij keten- en gebruikerstesten
Signaleren en oplossen van bugs en performanceproblemen
Meewerken aan code reviews en peer feedback om kwaliteit te waarborgen
Opzetten en onderhouden van testautomatisering (met Robot Framework)
Bewaken van productkwaliteit over de gehele keten heen
Begrijpen van de context en het product
Inleven in de eindgebruiker en meedenken over bruikbare en effectieve oplossingen
Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor het eindproduct, niet alleen het stukje code
Samenwerken met product owners, testers, UX-designers en andere stakeholders
Samenwerken in een team
Actieve deelname aan teamvergaderingen (bijv. stand-ups, retrospectives)
Kennis delen met collega’s en bijdragen aan een goede werksfeer
Helpen bij het oplossen van technische of procesmatige knelpunten
Onderhouden en verbeteren van bestaande systemen
Technische schuld aflossen en legacy-code moderniseren waar nodig
Monitoren van systemen (bijv. via logging, metrics, APM-tools)
Doorvoeren van verbeteringen op basis van feedback of gebruikersdata
Bijdragen aan innovatie en continu leren
Bijhouden van nieuwe technologieën en methodieken
Proactief voorstellen doen voor technische of procesverbeteringen
Zichzelf ontwikkelen via cursussen, conferenties of certificeringen

Achtergrond opdracht

IBS LH is verantwoordelijk voor de integratie van de gehele oplossing die gerealiseerd kan worden door de eigen teams van IBS LH, STS, GBS en raakvlakken binnen IBS. IBS LH stemt de architectuur af, stuurt de realisatie en de planning via de realisatieteams en verstrekt de opdrachten naar de raakvlakken. IBS LH neemt de lead bij testen over de onderdelen heen en stemt af met de business owner (productmanagement) over prioritering en implementatie- en releasemomenten.

Samen met de keten Loonheffingen staan we de komende jaren voor grote uitdagingen. De Europese en nationale wet- en regelgeving is sterk in beweging. Daarnaast is het applicatielandschap sterk verouderd. Om aan huidige en nieuwe wet- en regelgeving te kunnen blijven voldoen moet het applicatielandschap worden gemoderniseerd, met gebruikmaking van state-of-the-art architectuurprincipes en technologieën. Hierbij moet voortdurend de afweging worden gemaakt tussen enerzijds het tijdig kunnen voldoen aan de eisen van wetgeving en business en het anderzijds realiseren van een robuust en wendbaar applicatielandschap om dit ook in de toekomst te kunnen doen.

De IBS Loonheffingen heeft een duidelijke visie op wat we willen bereiken voor de toekomst:

top IT werkgever worden
ontwikkeling richting DevOps visie
zelforganiserende teams met kans om je zelf te ontplooien en je eigen inbreng naar voren te brengen
t-shaped (software engineers)
uitdagingen door complexiteit omgeving en meer nieuwe technologieën.

De Belastingdienst is de overheidsinstantie in Nederland die verantwoordelijk is voor het innen van belastingen en het uitvoeren van verschillende taken op het gebied van belastingwetgeving. De Belastingdienst zorgt ervoor dat burgers en bedrijven hun belastingen correct en tijdig betalen en voert controles uit om belastingontduiking tegen te gaan. Daarnaast verstrekt de Belastingdienst toeslagen en houdt zij toezicht op de naleving van fiscale regelgeving.

Are you a Software Engineer
with a passion for security, cloud-native technologies, and solving complex technical challenges? Join our Crypto Services
team and help build and maintain the critical platforms that safeguard our customers, enable secure banking, and protect the bank's digital infrastructure. Whether you're already experienced in cryptography or eager to grow into the field, you'll have the opportunity to work with modern technologies while making a real impact.

Your job

As a Software Engineer, you will be part of an agile DevOps team responsible for designing, developing, testing, deploying, and maintaining secure, resilient, and high-performing solutions. You will contribute throughout the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and solution design to implementation and operational support.

You take ownership of your work, actively contribute ideas, share knowledge with your teammates, and continuously improve both the software and the way of working. Together with your colleagues, you will build high-quality, maintainable, and future-proof solutions using modern technologies and platforms, including Microsoft Azure.

You will primarily develop secure backend services and APIs supporting key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) integrations. Working closely with security specialists, platform engineers, and product owners, you will help deliver critical security services that are used throughout the bank.

Working environment

At ABN AMRO, we believe in creating an open and supportive environment where you can learn, experiment, make mistakes, and celebrate successes. We value feedback, collaboration, and continuous improvement, and we are committed to your professional and personal growth. As part of Platforms & Technology, the foundation of ABN AMRO's digital landscape, you'll work on meaningful challenges that help shape the future of secure banking. We encourage you to take ownership, seize opportunities, and make an impact.

About IT Platforms & Technology.
Within ABN AMRO, IT Platforms & Technology (P&T) provides the foundational platforms and services that enable the bank to operate securely, reliably, and efficiently. This includes our cloud platforms, network infrastructure, data centers, developer platforms, and the tools that support the entire software development lifecycle.

About Service Integration & Orchestration.
The Service Integration & Orchestration (SI&O) department plays a key role in ensuring the stability, security, and continuous availability of the bank's IT landscape. Alongside governance and operational responsibilities, SI&O is home to several DevOps teams that build and operate critical services used across the organization.

About Crypto Services.
The Crypto Services team develops and operates the platforms that enable secure banking across ABN AMRO. Our services include key management, certificate lifecycle management, and Hardware Security Module (HSM) solutions that support critical applications and infrastructure throughout the bank.

As part of the Crypto Services team, you will contribute to the platforms that form the foundation of secure banking. From key management and certificate lifecycle management to Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), the services you build and maintain are essential for protecting customers, securing critical business processes, and enabling the bank to operate safely and reliably every day.

Your profile

We're looking for a Software Engineer who enjoys building secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions and is eager to grow within the cryptographic domain.

What You'll Bring

Hands-on experience writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code in Java, C#, or comparable programming languages, with a strong focus on engineering best practices and code quality.
Hands-on experience with Python, particularly in developing, securing, and optimizing APIs.
Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, with a focus on clean architecture and maintainable codebases.
Ability to analyze, optimize, and improve API performance in distributed systems.
Curiosity and willingness to learn and grow within the cryptographic domain.

Don't tick every box?

Previous experience in cryptography is not required. We are looking for a software engineer with a solid technical foundation, a security-minded mindset, and the motivation to learn and grow within the cryptographic domain. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every qualification, we'd still love to hear from you.

We are offering

We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.

In addition, we offer:

An attractive gross monthly salary in Hay 9 based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.
Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work.
Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.

You can find more information about our employment conditions and salary scales in our Collective Labour Agreement (CLA), which applies to this vacancy.

Interested?

If you believe this role matches your experience and ambitions, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply online. If you'd like to learn more about the team or the role, feel free to contact Patrick Haak (patrick.haak@nl.abnamro.com)

Your Future: Inclusive, Innovative, Sustainable

At ABN AMRO, we believe in " Banking for better, for generations to come.
" Equal opportunities for everyone are a crucial foundation, as we strive for an inclusive culture where all employees feel seen, heard, and valued. Our vision of being a personal bank in the digital age
aligns perfectly with the demand for surprising insights and innovative solutions, born from a diverse interplay of cultures and experiences. We focus on customer experience, sustainability, and building a future-proof bank, conducting annual reviews to ensure equal pay for equal work. Join a bank that embraces ingenuity and ambition, and make an impact with us for a better future.

If you want to apply for the B-Able or Reboot program, make sure to mention it both in the title and the content of your resume.

All unsolicited resumes sent to us will be considered property of ABN AMRO BANK N.V. In this case, ABN AMRO will not be held liable to pay a placement fee.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Solution Engineer – Applied AI FDE
jobs.description:
Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

Team Bio:

ServiceNow’s Applied AI Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
team is where bold ideas meet transformative action. We partner with our most strategic customers to shape the future of enterprise AI. Together, we identify high-value opportunities, accelerate business outcomes, and build reusable AI-native solutions that advance the Now AI Platform.

Our mission:
We partner deeply with our customers to build intelligent, scalable AI solutions that solve their most mission-critical challenges. By embedding in real-world complexity, we deliver fast, iterate with purpose, and transform every success into reusable patterns that accelerate transformation across the Now Platform and the broader enterprise.

Why This Role Matters

Enterprises are raising the bar. AI initiatives must deliver business value—not just promise potential. That means taking cutting-edge LLM capabilities and turning them into resilient, secure, and scalable software.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE)
, you act as the CTO of the build—owning everything from backend services to LLM pipelines and front-end integrations. You partner with customers in the field to design, implement, and deliver solution-ready builds in agile sprints. Your software becomes the reference implementation for scalable GenAI in the enterprise. You codify patterns, shape internal tooling, and accelerate innovation—delivering systems that are battle-tested in production and scalable across industries.

Who You Are

You are a systems-minded, AI-native engineer who ships real software. You own the full stack—and are equally motivated by elegant APIs, intuitive UIs, and scalable orchestration pipelines. You think like a product-minded CTO, balancing creativity with pragmatism to deliver impact.

You embed deeply with customer teams, diagnose root problems, and architect AI-powered workflows that run at scale. You don’t just debug code—you debug systems, context, and customer pain points.

You Will

Build solution-ready LLM-enabled applications that span backend logic, data orchestration, and front-end UI
Operate in the field, working side-by-side with customers to adapt, deploy, and iterate in live environments
Codify reusable assets—libraries, prompts, scaffolds—to accelerate future engagements
Shape developer experience by sharing feedback with platform and product teams

What You’ll Do

Deliver Production - ready solution in agile end-to-end sprints
Engineer with versatility: APIs, orchestration pipelines, vector DBs, LLM frameworks, UI components
Operate with agility: integrate with legacy systems, navigate ambiguity, ship safely at speed
Codify patterns: build scaffolds, SDKs, and documentation to scale success across customers
Influence platform: inform product strategy through field-tested insights and extensible code

What Success Looks Like

Production-grade delivery: Your solution builds consistently convert to scaled deployments in production environments
Reusable impact: You author libraries, prompts, and scaffolds that power multiple deployments and projects
Platform influence: Your work shapes internal tooling and is integrated into platform roadmap and primitives
Velocity and precision: You move fast without breaking things—shaping resilient, secure systems in high-stakes contexts
Engineering leadership: You are trusted by architects, PMs, and customer teams to lead implementation from zero to one

Qualifications

What You Bring:

Experience: In leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI’s potential impact on the function or industry
Relevant Experience: 10+ years of software engineering, including 2+ years building systems in customer-facing or embedded roles
System architecture: Proven ability to design and implement AI-native software in production environments
Engineering depth: Strength in backend (Python, Node.js, Java), frontend (React, Angular), APIs (REST/GraphQL)
LLM tooling: Familiarity with LangChain, Semantic Kernel, prompt chaining, vector search, and context management
Performance & observability: Skilled in debugging distributed systems, tuning for latency, and implementing monitoring
Platform mindset: Can contribute to shared SDKs and tools, raising engineering velocity for the whole org
Product sensibility: Prioritize for user value, MVP iteration, and long-term scale
DevOps fluency: Experience deploying in AWS, Azure, or GCP with CI/CD, containers, and infra-as-code
Field readiness: Able to travel up to 30% to embed onsite and deliver where it matters

Preferred Qualifications

Experience integrating AI into SaaS platforms like ServiceNow or Salesforce
Track record of production deployments in secure, regulated enterprise environments
Contributions to dev experience tooling, frameworks, or reusable AI scaffolds

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

jobs.title: Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT Utrecht & Haarlem - Jobbird.com
jobs.description:
Werk aan innovatieve IT-oplossingen die Nederland in beweging houden. Maak impact, groei mee en bouw aan de digitale toekomst van NS.

Jij zorgt voor de mobiliteit van Nederland
Veel ontwikkel-mogelijkheden
Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden

Daarom wil je als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werken

Je werkt aan technologie die direct bijdraagt aan betrouwbaar en toekomstbestendig treinvervoer.
Je ontwikkelt en verbetert een bedrijfskritisch MES-platform op het snijvlak van IT, OT, techniek en productie.
Je krijgt veel ruimte om slimme oplossingen te ontwerpen voor de modernisering van onze treinen in Haarlem, dicht op de operatie.

Dit ga je doen als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT

Als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT bij NS werk je aan het Manufacturing Execution System (MES) binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Dit bedrijfskritische platform, gebaseerd op AspenTech, ondersteunt de productie- en onderhoudsprocessen waarmee treinen worden gemoderniseerd. Daarmee heeft jouw werk direct impact op de beschikbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid van onze treinen.

Deze functie is anders dan een klassieke fullstack ontwikkelaarsrol. Je werkt niet alleen aan software, maar ook aan configuratie, integraties, procesontwerp en technische continuïteit binnen een operationele productieomgeving. Je schakelt met operators, productieondersteuning, functioneel beheerders, ontwikkelaars en andere collega’s om gebruikersvragen te vertalen naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

Je ontwikkelt nieuwe functionaliteiten, verbetert bestaande oplossingen en helpt verstoringen structureel op te lossen. Daarbij werk je met onder andere SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en MES-processen. Je denkt mee over de technische roadmap, migraties, beveiliging en de toekomst van het MES-landschap. Zo bouw je mee aan een platform dat belangrijk is voor de modernisering van treinen én voor de dagelijkse operatie in de fabriek.

Concreet houd je je bezig met:

Je ontwikkelt, configureert en onderhoudt oplossingen binnen het AspenTech MES-platform.
Je vertaalt productie- en onderhoudsprocessen naar robuuste, schaalbare en praktisch toepasbare technische ontwerpen.
Je werkt aan nieuwe functionaliteiten, API-koppelingen, data-integraties en optimalisaties binnen het MES-landschap.
Je analyseert complexe vraagstukken en lost technische verstoringen structureel op, soms direct in contact met de fabriek.
Je neemt een leidende rol in technische ontwerpkeuzes en bewaakt de kwaliteit, continuïteit en veiligheid van oplossingen.
Je werkt nauw samen met functioneel beheerders, een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers zoals operators en productieondersteuning.
Je denkt mee over technische migraties, contracten, beveiliging en toekomstige ontwikkelingen op de roadmap van het MES-platform.
Je ondersteunt bij releases, migraties en technische verbetertrajecten.
Je deelt kennis binnen het team en helpt collega’s technisch verder, zodat de afhankelijkheid van enkele kennishouders kleiner wordt.

Hier ga je werken

Je komt terecht in het MES-team binnen NS Treinmodernisering in Haarlem. Hier worden treinen vernieuwd, verbeterd en toekomstbestendig gemaakt. Binnen die omgeving speelt digitalisering een steeds grotere rol. Het MES-platform ondersteunt collega’s op de werkvloer bij productie- en onderhoudsprocessen en vormt daarmee een belangrijke schakel tussen IT, OT en de dagelijkse operatie.

Het team bestaat uit een Product Owner, Scrum Master, ontwikkelaars, een technisch applicatiebeheerder en een functioneel beheerder. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat het MES-platform stabiel blijft draaien én meegroeit met de behoefte van de fabriek. Je werkt in een omgeving waar techniek, softwareontwikkeling en productie samenkomen. Dat vraagt om nauwkeurigheid, eigenaarschap, samenwerking en de rust om ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. De ene dag werk je aan een strategische verbetering van het platform, de andere dag help je een verstoring oplossen die direct impact heeft op de productie. Juist die combinatie van IT, techniek en operatie maakt deze functie interessant voor een ontwikkelaar die graag dicht bij de praktijk werkt.

Dit zijn de functie-eisen

Je bent een ervaren IT-professional of softwareontwikkelaar die technische diepgang combineert met een praktische aanpak. Je vindt het interessant om complexe systemen te doorgronden en krijgt energie van het slimmer maken van productieprocessen. Je kunt zelfstandig werken, denkt goed na over je aanpak en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen.

Verder herken je jezelf in het volgende:

Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in de richting van technische informatica, software engineering, industriële automatisering of vergelijkbaar.
Je hebt ruime ervaring als software engineer, systems engineer, IT engineer of ontwikkelaar binnen complexe en bedrijfskritische IT-landschappen.
Je hebt ervaring met of aantoonbare affiniteit met MES-systemen, productieomgevingen en industriële automatisering.
Ervaring met AspenTech MES, ASM of vergelijkbare MES-platformen is een sterke pré.
Je hebt goede kennis van SQL, databases en systeemintegraties.
Je hebt ervaring met JavaScript, TypeScript en bij voorkeur enige kennis van .NET.
Je hebt ervaring met API’s, koppelingen, data-integraties en technische architecturen.
Je kunt zelfstandig verstoringen analyseren, prioriteiten bepalen en tot een structurele oplossing komen.
Je communiceert duidelijk en weet technische oplossingen begrijpelijk te maken voor verschillende doelgroepen, van ontwikkelaars tot gebruikers op de werkvloer.
Je bent stressbestendig, verandergericht en zelfbewust: je blijft rustig bij onverwachte situaties en durft keuzes te maken met oog voor kwaliteit en samenwerking.

Dit zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de dynamische wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. En als één van de mooiste werkgevers van Nederland hebben we nog meer te bieden. Voor deze functie onder meer:

Een salaris tussen € 3.743,- en € 6.491,- bruto per maand op basis van schaal 60 en een 36-urige werkweek. Je inschaling is afhankelijk van je werkervaring.
De mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en flexibele werktijden, in overleg.
Een 36-urige werkweek.
3% eindejaarsuitkering, 8% vakantietoeslag en een uitstekende pensioenregeling.
Bij goed functioneren krijg je na een jaar een vast contract.
Gratis treinreizen in de 2e klas. Reizen in de 1e klas kan tegen een kleine eigen bijdrage.
Je gezin reist gratis mee in de daluren.
144 uur wettelijk verlof op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, plus extra verlof afhankelijk van je leeftijd. Dit is minimaal een week.
De mogelijkheid om 3 christelijke feestdagen om te ruilen voor 3 niet-christelijke feestdagen.
Korting op Europese treinreizen zodra je 1 jaar bij NS werkt.
Een keuzeplan met onder andere een fietsenplan, extra pensioenopbouw of extra vakantiedagen.

Wil je meer weten? Bekijk dan onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en cao.

Solliciteren naar deze baan

Wil jij als Fullstack ontwikkelaar MES IT/OT werken aan software, integraties en productieprocessen die direct bijdragen aan de modernisering van treinen? Solliciteer dan direct via de sollicitatiebutton. Binnen enkele minuten ontvang je een automatische sollicitatiebevestiging. Binnen 2 weken reageren wij op jouw sollicitatie.

In onze werving nemen we bij NS ook Learning Agility mee, omdat we het belangrijk vinden om niet alleen te kijken naar wat je al kunt, maar ook naar hoe je leert, ontwikkelt en meebeweegt met verandering. Zo maken we samen een duurzame match.

Je kunt je sollicitatie richten aan Jeroen van den Berg, Corporate Recruiter IT.

Heb je nog vragen over het sollicitatieproces?
Mail dan naar Karin van onze frontoffice via . Heb je liever telefonisch contact? Bel dan met onze frontoffice op 088-6713666.

Goed om te weten

Een achtergrondonderzoek, waaronder een VOG (Verklaring omtrent Gedrag), maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure. Dit omvat ook het tekenen van een integriteitsverklaring en geheimhoudingsverklaring.
We vinden het belangrijk dat iedereen die bij ons werkt zich thuis voelt. Dit zie je terug in ons aannamebeleid. Lees hier meer.
Met deze vacature werven wij zelf onze nieuwe collega. Dit is géén oproep voor acquisitie. De functie kan niet op interim basis worden vervuld. Bekijk daarvoor onze inhuurpagina.

Op NS kun je rekenen

Werken bij NS betekent dat jij hét verschil kunt maken in de wereld van duurzame mobiliteit. Jij helpt mee om Nederland bereikbaar te houden, voor iedereen. Bij NS krijg je veel vrijheid. We beloven je dat geen dag hetzelfde is. De kernwaarden van NS zijn open en betrouwbaar. Wij gaan voor resultaat en willen vooruit.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Sollicitatie ontvangenWe hebben jouw sollicitatie goed ontvangen en laten je binnen 2 weken weten of we met je verdergaan in deze procedure.
(Online) sollicitatiegesprekWe nodigen je uit voor een sollicitatiegesprek met de recruiter en teammanager. Het gesprek vindt digitaal plaats via Microsoft Teams of bij ons op kantoor.
VervolggesprekWe nodigen je uit voor een vervolggesprek bij ons op kantoor.
Arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek Digitaal bespreken we het arbeidsvoorwaardelijke aanbod en heb je de mogelijkheid om vragen te stellen.

jobs.title: AI Solutions Engineer, Discovery Data Science
jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

The Role

Do you enjoy building software and finding practical ways to make AI useful? Join Genmab’s Discovery Data Science team in Utrecht and help turn AI models into reliable tools that scientists can use in their everyday work!

In this hands-on engineering role, you will help develop, deploy and maintain applications and workflows that support antibody discovery. Your work could involve connecting a model to a data platform, automating a data processing task, or improving an application based on feedback from the scientists using it. Across these projects, your contribution will help make AI solutions accessible, useful and dependable.

You will join an international team of data scientists, software engineers and research scientists who bring different technical and scientific perspectives. Working closely with a senior AI Solutions Engineer, you will take on defined technical tasks, receive guidance on priorities and implementation, and gradually build your experience across the development and deployment lifecycle. You will contribute your own ideas, ask questions and work through technical challenges with colleagues.

Your main focus will be software engineering and implementation, taking promising models and prototypes and helping them work reliably within our existing systems. You will also stay close to the people using what you build, gathering feedback and making improvements together.

Some grounding in life sciences or scientific research would be helpful, whether gained through your studies, projects or work experience. You do not need specialist knowledge of biology or antibody discovery, but an interest in understanding the scientific context will help you connect your engineering work to the team’s needs. This role offers the opportunity to build on that foundation while developing your technical expertise and contributing to research into new antibody therapies.

This position is based in Utrecht, with 32–40 working hours per week and approximately 2–3 days per week in the office.

Anticipated start date: 1 January 2027.

Responsibilities

Build and improve AI-enabled applications and workflows in collaboration with data scientists, software engineers and Discovery colleagues.
Help turn research prototypes into maintainable software that can be used reliably in day-to-day scientific work.
Develop data processing, model inference and automation pipelines, connecting them with existing APIs, data platforms and scientific applications.
Support the deployment and maintenance of AI and machine learning models, including cloud and container-based environments.
Write clear, testable Python code and contribute to documentation, code reviews, version control and automated testing and deployment.
Monitor applications and workflows, investigate technical issues and work with colleagues to resolve them.
Gather feedback from scientific users and translate it into practical improvements to the tools you help build.
Explore relevant AI technologies, including generative AI and AI agents, with guidance from experienced colleagues.
Share what you learn and contribute to technical discussions within the team.

Requirements

We are looking for someone early in their engineering career who enjoys building things, solving practical problems and learning with others.

What You Will Bring

A BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Engineering or a related technical or quantitative discipline.
Relevant experience developing software applications. As a guide, this could be around 1–3 years of professional experience, or substantial experience gained through academic projects, internships, open-source contributions or personal projects.
Good Python programming skills and familiarity with software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), testing, documentation and writing modular, maintainable code that others can understand and use.
Hands-on experience working with machine learning models or large language models (LLMs), for example training or fine-tuning a model, running inference, or building an application around a model’s API.
A practical approach to troubleshooting, including exploring possible solutions and asking colleagues for input when needed.
A collaborative approach and the ability to explain your work, ask questions and discuss feedback with people from different backgrounds.
An interest in applying engineering skills to scientific research.
Fluent English, both written and spoken.

Additional Experience That Would Be Helpful

We do not expect you to have experience in all of the following, and there will be opportunities to develop these skills in the role:

Cloud platforms such as AWS, container tools such as Docker, and CI/CD workflows.
APIs, databases and data processing pipelines.
Deploying, monitoring or maintaining machine learning applications.
Building generative AI applications or working with AI agents.
Some grounding in life sciences or scientific research, gained through your studies, projects or work experience. Specialist knowledge of biology or antibody discovery is not required.

If you recognise yourself in the core requirements but are still developing some of the additional skills, we encourage you to apply. We would be interested to hear about what you have built, how you approached technical challenges and what you would like to learn next!

The proposed gross annual/monthly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

EUR59.568,00---89.352,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

Benefits

When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

Pension
Health insurance and wellness benefits
Paid time off
Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

About Genmab

Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. Je beschikt over een sterk analytisch vermogen en weet complexe vraagstukken te vertalen naar praktische oplossingen.

Ervaring met AI-technologieën, machine learning en generatieve AI-oplossingen.

Naast een uitdagende functie binnen een innovatieve omgeving waar technologie en vakmanschap samenkomen, bieden wij volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en direct impact te maken op de digitale transformatie van Royal van Lent. jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

At AG Solution, we build intelligent solutions for the process industry, combining automation, process control, data management, and MES/MOM systems to help manufacturers reach operational excellence.

Now part of the Quariq Group, we are one of Europe’s leading Industry 4.0 partners

At AG Solution, you’ll work on meaningful projects that drive efficiency, sustainability, and digital transformation for leading manufacturers worldwide.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Engineer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Engineer implements, integrates, tests, deploys and supports industrial applications across manufacturing sites. The role configures and implements global use cases and applications.

The Application Engineer is the technical bridge between plants, application owners, developers, infrastructure and cybersecurity teams, software vendors and system integrators. The role covers both purchased or configured applications and internally built solutions; it is neither limited to software development nor to coordination.

Assigned scope:

Global OT applications across manufacturing sites, including MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT and CMMS domains.
Purchased, configured and internally developed applications and their interfaces to plant and business systems.

Primary emphasis:

Applications are deployed safely, consistently and with clear acceptance evidence.
Plant systems exchange accurate and reliable data through governed interfaces.
Sites receive effective onboarding, technical support and operational handover.
Incidents and recurring technical problems are resolved at the appropriate support level.
Global templates and standards are applied without losing control of necessary local adaptations.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Implementation and Integration:

Configure and implement applications, templates and technical components in accordance with the approved solution design.
Gather requirements to integrate applications with PLC, SCADA, DCS, MES/MOM, IIoT, historians and business systems such as ERP, LIMS or QMS.
Configure and troubleshoot industrial data exchange using technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ensure that global libraries, naming conventions, templates, interfaces and deployment standards are followed.
Document any approved local deviation from the global template, including its justification and approval, in the application documentation.
Review technical and functional deliveries from developers, vendors and system integrators and challenge gaps in quality, maintainability or operability.

Testing and Validation:

Translate approved requirements and designs into a complete and traceable technical test scope.
Prepare and execute functional, integration and regression tests and support FAT, SAT and user acceptance testing.
Diagnose bugs, coordinate correction and test cycles, and maintain clear test evidence and release documentation.
Verify connectivity, data integrity, performance, resilience, security controls and operational readiness.
Confirm that acceptance criteria are met before recommending release or production deployment.

Deployment and Site Onboarding:

Lead the technical work required to take an application from a controlled release into stable plant operation.
Assess site readiness, infrastructure, signals, interfaces, data availability and local dependencies.
Coordinate technical activities with plant stakeholders, local OT teams, vendors and system integrators.
Execute or supervise installation, configuration, commissioning and cut-over activities.
Provide hypercare, technical training, documentation and a clear handover to support and site teams.

Operations and Support:

Provide ITIL-based L2/L3 application support: advanced troubleshooting, functional bug-fixing and technical incident escalation across sites (ITIL support levels, not Purdue Model network layers).
Perform problem management: conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for recurring application errors.
Manage technical change requests: oversee software modifications from assessment through testing, release and production deployment.
Monitor application health: track application performance, data interfaces (APIs) and support trends to recommend continuous improvements.
Maintain knowledge databases: manage technical documentation, application runbooks, release notes and Known-Error Databases (KEDB).

Plant and Technical Team Interface:

Act as the practical interface between plant operations and the teams that design, build and supply the applications.
Translate plant constraints and operational issues into actionable technical requirements and bugs.
Explain technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions to plant and business stakeholders.
Coordinate effectively with the Application Owner on priorities, scope, standards and acceptance.
Work with developers on build activities and with delivery leads or Scrum Masters on planning and execution.
Challenge vendors and system integrators on technical quality, delivery evidence and issue resolution, escalating commercial or roadmap matters to the Application Owner.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Strong knowledge of at least one relevant application domain: MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or CMMS, and of interfaces to PLC, SCADA and DCS systems.
Practical integration knowledge using OPC UA, MQTT, REST APIs and SQL.
Ability to read, adapt or create components using Python, C#, Java or JavaScript when needed.
Working knowledge of versioning, release, incident, problem and change-management practices.
Working knowledge of ISA-95 principles, OT cybersecurity and regulated validation requirements where applicable.

Behavioral Competencies:

Plant-oriented, pragmatic and structured, with strong ownership of technical issues.
Constructive challenge of delivery evidence from developers, vendors and system integrators.
Clear cross-functional communication across plant, specialist and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in automation, electrical, software or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience with industrial applications, automation, MES/MOM, SCADA, IIoT or comparable manufacturing systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated responsibility across multiple sites or complex industrial programs.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany, plus a senior regional position in the north-eastern United States.
Home-based or hybrid working with regular domestic and international travel to manufacturing sites.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Application Engineer:

Together with the Project Managers, defines implementation and configuration approaches within approved standards.
Stops or rejects a technical deployment when readiness or acceptance criteria are not met.
Recommends fixes, improvements and standard changes based on operational evidence.
Escalates architecture, security, scope and vendor-performance risks.
The role does not own application strategy, roadmap, backlog or commercial vendor decisions, does not act only as a software developer without integration, testing, support and site responsibilities, does not replace the plant's operational ownership or bypass agreed OT governance, and does not approve material deviations from global standards without the relevant owner or authority.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: priorities, scope, standards, acceptance and escalation of commercial or roadmap matters.
Plant operations and local OT teams: site readiness, deployment activities, onboarding, training, support and operational handover.
Developers, delivery leads and Scrum Masters: build activities, defect resolution, planning and release execution.
Infrastructure and cybersecurity teams: interfaces, security controls, architecture dependencies and technical risk.
Software vendors and system integrators: technical quality, delivery evidence, testing and issue resolution.
Business and functional stakeholders (production, quality, maintenance, supply chain): technical options, dependencies, risks and decisions affecting plant operations.
Project managers: rollout planning and execution; sequencing, dependencies and escalation of deviations.
