jobs.title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager
in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.
Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.
Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.
Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1
Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.
Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.
Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements
Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.
Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.
Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.
Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.
Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You Bring

Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.
Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.
Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.
Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.
Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.
Excellent written and spoken English

You Enjoy

Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.
Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders
Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
EBS is a rapidly expanding, entrepreneurial technology company and part of Alarm.com. Alarm.com is the leading cloud-based platform for smart security and the Internet of Things. More than 7.6+ million home and business owners depend on our solutions every day to make their properties safer, smarter, and more efficient. We’re innovating new technologies in rapidly evolving spaces including AI, video analytics, facial recognition, machine learning, energy analytics, and more.

Our Home Automation Experience (HAX) team owns the full home automation domain at Alarm.com including devices, device groups, rules, schedules, scenes, and automation-related notifications, for both customers and dealers, across web, mobile, and the backend services that make it all work. Alarm.com is a smart-home-as-a-service platform — our products reach end customers through a network of professional security and smart-home dealers who install, configure, and support our systems, which means HAX builds for two distinct audiences with very different needs. If 'intuitive, accessible, reliable home automation' is the kind of problem you want to spend the next several years on, this is a good place to do it.

As a Software Engineer II on HAX Team Automation Pod, you'll support the delivery of high-impact features end to end, from partnering with Product Management and Quality Engineering, collaborating with your peer engineers, to being involved in and owning technical designs and feature implementations. You'll focus primarily on backend development and data, and edge computing infrastructure on our panels for all of our automation features including rules, schedules, and more.

Alarm.com is one of the few places you can build consumer products that ship at a consumer scale across this kind of technology surface (wireless, software, hardware/device) without changing companies. Engineers here go deep in their area and stay curious about everything else. We are building a new team in Krakow.

Our employees work fully from the office with the possibility to work remotely occasionally.

Key Responsibilities

Develop backend and on device software for a wide variety of platforms and technologies.

Engage in the research, evaluation, and application of new technologies and methodologies to solve challenging project goals
Write coherent, organized code. Ideal candidates must be comfortable working on a complicated codebase with high levels of abstraction

jobs.description:
The Role

You will be joining our client’s Data Ingestion team, a highly focused group currently consisting of 5 developers, 1 QA, and 1 Product Manager. This is a newly created position due to team growth. The role is 90-95% backend-focused, with development time split evenly (approximately 50/50) between building new features and handling bug fixes/support.

Work Conditions

Location: Hybrid model in the Warsaw office (3 days per week on-site).
Hours: Monday to Friday, approximately 9 AM to 6 PM (Core team often has quiet/non-working Fridays, making it a great day for deep work).
Work/Life Balance: Regular hours with strictly no on-call duties.

About The Product

Our client’s platform transforms live sports broadcasts into personalized, publication-ready highlight packages while games are actively in progress. The system ingests live play-by-play game data, automatically analyzes and tags video streams to identify key moments, creates video highlights, and publishes content directly to platforms like YouTube. The system processes massive data volumes with zero tolerance for latency, directly powering downstream consumer-facing media products.

What You’ll Be Doing

High-Level Engineering

Work independently to scope tasks, architect solutions, and lead technical initiatives without needing micromanagement.
Apply strong system design and architecture principles to low-latency, event-driven microservices.
Bridge ML models into production by building resilient deployment pipelines.
Own end-to-end service delivery from initial RFC design through zero-downtime deployment and post-launch telemetry.
Debug distributed performance bottlenecks and scale compute clusters handling concurrent 24/7 media processing.

Potential Daily Tasks

Provider Integration: Analyze third-party REST APIs, write C#/.NET 8 ingestion managers and parsers, and configure JSON data mapping to internal MS SQL Server models (e.g., onboarding new leagues and clients).
Pipeline Enhancement: Expand existing capabilities (such as rosters, coaching staff, and event lineups) and implement robust error-handling for edge cases where providers send malformed or unexpected data.
Data Troubleshooting: Investigate production bugs by tracing data execution—comparing raw provider payloads in Azure Blob Storage against database records and Coralogix system logs.
End-to-End Delivery: Drive the full software lifecycle within a monorepo architecture, handling active development, pull requests, code reviews, and deploying via GitHub Actions and Azure DevOps pipelines.
Collaborative Design: Work closely with technical leads to refine solution architectures, proactively clarify Jira requirements, and document systems in Confluence within a highly responsive, knowledge-sharing team environment.

What We Expect

Must-have

Experience Level: from 5 years of backend development experience.
Tech Stack: Strong expertise in C# and .NET Core 6+ (preferably .NET 8).
Architecture & Data: Solid hands-on experience with Microservices and SQL.
System Design: Proven experience in system design and software architecture.
Education: Formal university degree in Computer Science or a closely related technical field.
AI Integration: Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding tools (such as Claude, Cursor, or ML frameworks) in your development workflow.
Work Style: Highly independent, capable of scoping out complex tasks, and comfortable taking ownership without micromanagement.
Track Record: A stable employment history demonstrating tenure (no frequent job hopping without legitimate reasons), ideally within established tech companies (preferred over banks or very small startups where senior mentorship was lacking).

Nice-to-have

Experience with messaging queues, event-driven architecture, and modern design patterns.
Full-stack capabilities or some frontend development experience.
Cloud infrastructure experience, preferably Azure (though AWS and GCP are perfectly acceptable).

Why This Role Is Worth Your Time

Impact: Direct ownership of high-concurrency event pipelines where code changes instantly impact live, broadcast-level media products published to global audiences.
Modern AI Practices: Pragmatic adoption of AI engineering practices — AI coding assistants (Claude) are an expected, integrated part of our client’s production workflows.
Great Work-Life Balance: Complex distributed systems engineering without the burnout—enjoy a predictable Monday-Friday schedule with zero on-call responsibilities.

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group
(Euronext: INPST) is Europe's leading out-of-home e-commerce delivery platform, operating over 50,000 automated parcel machines (APMs) and PUDO points across Poland, the UK, France, Italy, and Benelux
- processing tens of millions of transactions annually. Beyond logistics, InPost is building a full e-commerce services layer: InPost Pay is our integrated checkout and payments product embedded directly into the merchant journey
, with ambitions that extend into digital wallets, embedded finance, and AI-assisted commerce. This is fintech at logistics scale - and we are just getting started.

Job Description

As you probably know, a lot is happening at InPost. We build products and services that support millions of users and transactions every day. One of the key areas within our ecosystem is InPost Pay, where we develop solutions focused on digital payments, checkout experiences, and sales enablement.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who will take ownership of a growing engineering organization within the Pay domain
. This is an opportunity for a leader who can scale teams, develop engineering leaders, drive technical excellence, and remain a credible partner in architectural and technology discussions.

What will you be responsible for?

Driving the growth and scalability of technology teams supporting payment, checkout, and sales-related products.
Leading an engineering organization of approximately 24–25 engineers across 3 teams:
two teams led through Engineering Managers,
one team managed directly.

Developing Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and senior engineering talent while building a strong leadership pipeline.
Establishing and maintaining technical, architectural, and delivery standards across the entire domain.
Shaping technology strategy in close collaboration with Product, Business, and Engineering stakeholders.
Managing dependencies across teams and ensuring high-quality delivery at scale.
Identifying and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks that impact product development and business outcomes.
Defining and driving the domain's AI adoption strategy, identifying opportunities where AI can improve engineering productivity, software quality, and operational efficiency.
Promoting responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation across engineering teams while measuring business and engineering impact.
Leading the organization through data-driven decision-making by defining, monitoring, and improving domain-level KPIs, OKRs, SLAs, and engineering performance metrics.
Using engineering insights and metrics to continuously improve delivery effectiveness, platform reliability, team productivity, and customer outcomes.
Representing the engineering organization in strategic initiatives and cross-functional leadership discussions.

Qualifications

An ideal profile includes:

10+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and multi-team engineering organizations.
Strong technical foundation gained as a Software Engineer.
Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Excellent understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and modern backend engineering practices.
Experience working with cloud environments (Google Cloud is a strong advantage).
Experience defining technical standards, SDLC processes, governance models, and engineering operating frameworks.
Ability to translate engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes and effectively communicate with senior stakeholders.

Must have:

Hands-on technical background in the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot) or equivalent enterprise microservices stack (e.g., .NET/C#); sufficient depth to be a credible technical partner in architecture reviews and engineering decisions.
Experience within a production environment.
Experience operating in large-scale product organizations.
Proven success in building and scaling engineering organizations through leaders.
Experience implementing or scaling AI-enabled engineering practices and tools.
Strong understanding of engineering metrics, KPIs, OKRs, and organizational performance management.
Ability to use data and measurable outcomes to drive technology and organizational decisions.

Nice to have:

Experience in fintech, digital payments, checkout platforms, or embedded finance products.
Experience working in organizations building payment processing, commerce, digital wallet, or transaction-heavy platforms.
Background in successful technology scale-ups that have grown both products and engineering organizations rapidly.
Experience in regulated crypto fintech - crypto exchanges, digital asset custodians, or blockchain-based payment infrastructure operating under financial supervision (e.g., MiCA, FCA, or equivalent licensing frameworks).
Demonstrated impact of AI adoption on engineering velocity, developer experience, or software quality.
Experience building management dashboards and using data analytics to drive strategic decisions.

Additional Information

Why Join InPost?

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership bench, extending your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industry.
 InPost is a growing company that offers an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits, training opportunities for self-development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and Flexible hours.
We offer the B2B type of contract for this role.

Job Description

Digital Asset System Architect (Platform Focus)

[TRIBE Innovation]

2026

Job Description

The financial industry is undergoing a fundamental transformation driven by Digital Assets, Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), and next-generation data platforms
. Euroclear is at the forefront of this evolution, building the foundations of a Digital Asset Platform
that will power future market infrastructures.

The Innovation Tribe is responsible for delivering these transformative capabilities, shaping how digital assets are issued, managed, and exchanged across ecosystems.

We are looking for a Digital Asset System Architect (Platform Focus)
who will define, evolve, and safeguard the vision of the Digital Asset Platform
. You will act as the technical authority and guardian of the platform
, ensuring that all teams contribute to a coherent, scalable, secure, and future-proof architecture
.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of architecture strategy, platform governance, and innovation
, where you will shape the long-term foundation of Euroclear’s digital asset capabilities while enabling teams to deliver efficiently and consistently.

Summary

In this role, you will drive the evolution of the Digital Asset Platform
, ensuring alignment between strategic vision and day-to-day delivery
.

You will work closely with engineering teams, solution architects, product leaders, and external partners
, guiding architectural decisions, validating implementations, and continuously improving the platform’s capabilities.

Your mission is to ensure that the platform remains consistent, reusable, secure, and scalable
, while enabling innovation and accelerating delivery across multiple initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

Define & Own Platform Vision Define and maintain the target architecture and long-term vision for the Digital Asset Platform, ensuring alignment with business strategy and innovation goals.
Drive Platform Evolution Continuously evolve platform capabilities (DLT, APIs, data, integration, security) to meet emerging business needs and technological opportunities.
Architecture Governance & Assurance Ensure that all teams follow the platform architecture principles, standards, and patterns, validating designs and implementations against the defined vision.
Act as Platform Design Authority Review solution designs, challenge inconsistencies, and ensure coherence across initiatives, acting as a trusted technical authority.
Enable Teams & Provide Guidance Support engineering teams and solution architects by providing clear guidance, reusable patterns, and architectural best practices, enabling efficient and aligned delivery.
Standardisation & Reuse Define reference architectures, reusable components, and “golden paths” to reduce fragmentation and accelerate delivery across teams
Platform Integration & Ecosystem Alignment Ensure alignment across platform components (DLT, APIs, cloud, data, security) and integration with internal and external ecosystems.
Security, Compliance & Resilience by Design Ensure the platform adheres to security, compliance, and operational resilience requirements, embedding these principles into architecture decisions.
Stakeholder Collaboration & Influence Partner with product, engineering, GTS, CISO, and external providers to ensure alignment and adoption of platform standards.
Innovation & Technology Watch Stay ahead of industry and technology trends (DLT, tokenization, digital assets), evaluating their impact and integrating relevant innovations into the platform.

Must Have

Deep experience in platform architecture, preferably in cloud-native and distributed systems environments
Strong knowledge of DLT / digital asset platforms / blockchain ecosystems.
Proven experience defining and governing architecture standards, patterns, and roadmaps
Strong understanding of API-driven architectures, event-driven systems, and integration patterns
Experience with cloud platforms (Azure preferred), CI/CD, and DevSecOps practices
Strong expertise in security-by-design, identity models, and compliance frameworks
Ability to balance strategic vision with pragmatic delivery constraints
Proven ability to guide multiple teams without direct authority
Strong communication and influencing skills across business and technical stakeholders

Nice To Have

Exposure to AI agents / Agentic AI concepts, including how autonomous agents can orchestrate workflows and service flow
Familiarity with financial services or market infrastructure

You Are

A visionary architect who can define a clear target state and inspire teams to align with it
A guardian of consistency, ensuring coherence and quality across complex initiatives
A pragmatic decision-maker, able to balance innovation, risk, and delivery speed
A natural influencer and collaborator, able to align diverse stakeholders without formal authority
Passionate about digital assets, DLT, and the future of financial market infrastructure
Comfortable operating in ambiguous, evolving environments, shaping direction while delivery is ongoing
Eager to continuously improve the platform and the way teams build on top of it

About Us

Why join us

Embark on your new adventure at Euroclear, and work at the heart of the global capital markets. We connect over 2,000 financial institutions across the globe. As an open and resilient infrastructure, we contribute to the stability of the financial markets. We help clients cut through complexity, lower costs, and mitigate risks of financial transactions. At Euroclear, we have the clear ambition to use our key role to facilitate and accelerate a sustainable global financial system.

What We Offer

Work closely with inspiring, supportive and engaged colleagues from more than 80 different countries.
Practice your talents in a highly professional international environment.
Join a learning and development environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing and training.
Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits.

Ways of working

Find your own optimal balance within our hybrid working model, where you can connect at the office 8 days a month and also benefit from remote working.

Great Place to Work for All

jobs.title: Industrial Data & AI Architect (M/F/NB)
jobs.description:
W Etteplan wierzymy, że skuteczne wdrożenie AI w przemyśle nie zaczyna się od modeli i algorytmów – zaczyna się od danych. Dobrze zaprojektowana architektura danych to fundament, bez którego żadne rozwiązanie AI nie będzie działać niezawodnie na poziomie operacyjnym.

W ramach strategii „Transformation with AI” budujemy zespół ekspertów, którzy pomagają organizacjom przemysłowym przejść od rozproszonych danych OT/IT do spójnych środowisk gotowych na analitykę, automatyzację i AI. Szukamy doświadczonego architekta, który poprowadzi ten obszar we współpracy z klientami i zespołami technicznymi Etteplan.

O zespole i środowisku pracy

Dołączysz do interdyscyplinarnego zespołu SES (Software & Embedded Solutions) w Polsce, który realizuje projekty cyfrowej transformacji dla klientów z sektorów produkcji, energetyki, farmaceutyki i infrastruktury krytycznej. Pracujemy z lokalnymi organizacjami oraz globalnymi klientami Etteplan w Europie Zachodniej i Skandynawii.

Jako Industrial Data & AI Architect będziesz działać na styku warstwy OT – systemów sterowania i automatyki – oraz IT, chmury i platform AI. Twoja praca tworzy fundament, na którym kolejne zespoły wdrażają rozwiązania analityczne, agentic AI i automatyzację procesów przemysłowych.

Twoja rola

Projektujesz i definiujesz architekturę danych dla środowisk przemysłowych – od poziomu urządzeń i systemów OT (PLC, SCADA, MES), przez warstwę integracji, aż po platformy chmurowe i usługi AI. Zapewniasz, że dane produkowane przez środowisko operacyjne klienta trafiają we właściwej jakości, latencji i strukturze tam, gdzie mogą realnie napędzać decyzje, usprawniać procesy oraz wspierać rozwój nowych produktów cyfrowych. To właśnie dzięki Twoim decyzjom architektonicznym dane z systemów przemysłowych stają się gotowe do wykorzystania w analityce, automatyzacji oraz rozwiązaniach AI wspierających działalność operacyjną klientów.

W tej roli będziesz odpowiadać za:

projektowanie architektury danych dla środowisk przemysłowych – od warstwy OT po chmurę,
analizę i mapowanie przepływów danych pomiędzy systemami PLC, SCADA, MES, ERP oraz platformami chmurowymi,
dobór i projektowanie pipeline'ów danych (batch i streaming) z użyciem narzędzi takich jak dbt, Apache Spark, Kafka lub ich odpowiedników,
definiowanie strategii integracji i standardów zarządzania danymi (data governance, data quality, data contracts),
projektowanie środowisk danych pod potrzeby AI: feature stores, wektorowe bazy danych oraz przygotowanie danych do treningu i inferencji modeli,
współpracę z klientami przy definiowaniu wymagań architektonicznych i kierunku transformacji danych,
wsparcie działań pre-sales poprzez udział w warsztatach odkrywczych, przygotowywanie koncepcji technicznych oraz wycenę zakresu prac,
współpracę z AI Solution Architects i Agentic Workflow Engineers w celu zapewnienia spójności między architekturą danych a rozwiązaniami AI,
definiowanie dobrych praktyk i wzorców architektonicznych w obszarze danych przemysłowych.

Jesteś naszym brakującym ogniwem, jeśli:

masz minimum 5 lat doświadczenia zawodowego, w tym doświadczenie w projektowaniu rozwiązań danych lub pełnieniu roli architekta/lead data engineera w środowiskach przemysłowych lub OT,
posiadasz praktyczną znajomość co najmniej jednej warstwy stosu przemysłowego: PLC/SCADA, MES lub ERP – i rozumiesz, jak dane przepływają między poziomami,
masz doświadczenie z narzędziami do przetwarzania i orkiestracji danych (np. Apache Spark, dbt, Airflow, Kafka lub podobne),
znasz co najmniej jedną platformę chmurową (Azure, AWS lub GCP) na poziomie projektowania rozwiązań danych,
potrafisz projektować architekturę z myślą o skalowalności, jakości danych i przyszłych potrzebach AI,
swobodnie komunikujesz się w języku angielskim, współpracując z klientami i zespołami w całej Europie,
potrafisz prowadzić rozmowy zarówno na poziomie technicznym (inżynierowie, architekci), jak i biznesowym (project ownerzy, managerowie),
dobrze odnajdujesz się w środowisku, w którym trzeba łączyć perspektywę klienta, biznesu i technologii,
myślisz architekturą i długofalowością rozwiązań, a nie wyłącznie doborem konkretnych narzędzi.

Docenimy również:

doświadczenie z platformami danych klasy enterprise: Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Delta Lake,
znajomość protokołów i standardów komunikacyjnych OT, takich jak OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus czy PROFINET,
doświadczenie z rozwiązaniami AI/ML, w tym wektorowymi bazami danych (np. Qdrant, Weaviate), MLflow lub feature stores,
znajomość architektur Data Lakehouse, Lambda lub Kappa,
doświadczenie w projektach Industry 4.0, IIoT lub związanych z cyfrowym bliźniakiem,
certyfikaty chmurowe (np. Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Data Analytics Specialty) lub związane z obszarem OT/security (ISA/IEC 62443),
znajomość języka niemieckiego umożliwiającą współpracę z klientami z regionu DACH.

W Etteplan możesz liczyć na:

udział w projektach z zakresu digitalizacji przemysłu i AI przy użyciu najnowszych technologii
współpracę z interdyscyplinarnymi zespołami ekspertów w Polsce i za granicą,
przestrzeń do eksperymentowania i proponowania nowych podejść architektonicznych,
elastyczność w zakresie formy współpracy oraz dostęp do benefitów i programów rozwojowych.

Jak przebiega proces rekrutacyjny?

Aplikacja Wyślij nam swoje CV w języku angielskim. W formularzu podaj oczekiwania finansowe, preferowaną formę współpracy i dostępność.

Rozmowa z HR (online, ok. 45 minut) Omówimy Twoją drogę zawodową, motywację i zainteresowanie obszarem transformacji danych i AI w przemyśle.
Rozmowa techniczna (online, ok. 90 minut) Spotkanie z osobami zaangażowanymi w projekty przemysłowe, skupione na architekturze danych, integracji systemów OT/IT oraz podejściu do projektowania rozwiązań.
Informacja zwrotna Wrócimy do Ciebie niezależnie od wyniku procesu.

Możesz też zajrzeć na naszą stronę internetową lub Facebooka i zobaczyć, co ciekawego się u nas dzieje!

Som en del av Saab Group är vi på Saab Kockums en ledande aktör inom varvs- och försvarsindustrin. Vi utvecklar och levererar marina system och fartyg som skyddar och stöder våra kunders behov runt om i världen. Vi strävar efter teknisk innovation och skapar lösningar som inte bara möter dagens behov utan också formar framtiden för vår bransch.

Just nu letar vi efter en driven och lösningsorienterad .NET-utvecklare till vårt team. I rollen kommer du att vara en nyckelspelare i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av våra IT- system som stödjer våra komplexa varvs- och försvarsprojekt.

Som .NET-utvecklare hos oss kommer du bl.a. att arbeta med:

Utveckla och anpassa systemlösningar med fokus på .NET-teknologier för att stödja våra varvs- och försvarsprojekt
Integrera ERP-, PLM- och CAD-lösningar för att koppla samman system som hanterar olika delar av design- och produktionsprocessen
Identifiera och åtgärda tekniska problem inom systemet, med fokus på prestanda, säkerhet och funktionalitet
Bidra till att optimera och automatisera interna processer som är kritiska för projektleveranser, identifiera flaskhalsar och förbättra effektiviteten i hela produktionskedjan. Skapa ökad flexibilitet genom att anpassa produktionen till förändrade krav och marknadsförutsättningar

: Lund, men resor kan förekomma både inrikes och utrikes.

Designerfarenhet av databaser, SQL-programmering och Entity Framework

Erfarenhet av .NET

Erfarenhet av systemintegrationer i en design- och produktionsmiljö som syftar till att sömnlöst sammanfoga olika IT-system och programvara för att skapa sammanhängande och effektivt arbetsflöde
3D CAD-programvara

Erfarenhet från varvs- eller försvarsindustrin
Kunskap om säkerhet och datasäkerhet inom systemutveckling

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

jobs.description:
Position:
Software Engineer
Location:
Solna, Stockholm, Sweden (Hybrid)

Move Security Forward with Acre

Are you passionate about transforming the future of security? Do you thrive in a collaborative, innovative environment where your contributions drive real impact? If so, Acre Security is the place for you. Join us in making the world a safer place, one innovation at a time.

About Acre

At Acre, we're not just building security solutions, we're empowering security professionals to adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. Since our inception in 2012, Acre has been at the forefront of innovation in access control, visitor management, and intrusion software. Our solutions are trusted by organisations in over 25 countries, delivering smarter, more adaptable, and easier-to-use security technologies that protect what matters most.

Your Impact

We're looking for an experienced Software Engineer
to join our Research & Development
team in Solna, Stockholm. The team builds and develops access control software solutions under the Omnis
brand.
In this role, you will:
Develop access control software solutions
– Contribute to the design, implementation, testing and maintenance of software throughout the development lifecycle.
Build software integrations
– Develop and maintain integrations with electronic hardware components including access control controllers, intrusion panels, wireless locks, DVRs, cameras and other security equipment.
Work as a full-stack developer
– Collaborate in an Agile development environment while delivering innovative security solutions.

What You'll Do

In addition to the above, your key responsibilities will include:
Design and develop the Omnis platform
– Lead or participate in the design, architecture and implementation of the Omnis access control system.
Develop software across the full lifecycle
– Design, implement, test and maintain software solutions from concept through deployment and support.
Create hardware and system integrations
– Work with a range of connected security devices and software integrations, primarily developed in C#.
Collaborate with stakeholders
– Participate in design reviews, code reviews and demonstrations with peers and stakeholders.
Support Agile development practices
– Contribute to an Agile development environment while maintaining high-quality software standards.

What You'll Bring

To succeed in this role, you'll need:
Relevant education and experience
– Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with at least 5 years of post-graduate experience in embedded software development.
Strong programming expertise
– Proficiency programming in C/C++ and C#.
Technical systems knowledge
– Familiarity with computer system architecture and application processor (SoC) fundamentals including caches, buses, memory controllers and DMA.
Database and networking experience
– Experience working with relational databases, preferably SQLBase, together with TCP/IP and networking knowledge.
Strong software engineering skills
– Experience with source control, defect tracking, design documentation, customer documentation, software debugging and Agile development processes.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
Familiarity with access control, intrusion detection or video management systems.
Experience leveraging AI for design and development work.
Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Effective communication, collaboration and interpersonal skills.
A strong team-player mindset.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Swedish.

What's in It for You

We strive to do more than just match your ambitions. When you join Acre, you'll have access to a range of exciting opportunities:
Be part of a disruptor
– Help move security forward with a company that challenges the status quo and redefines industry standards.
Learn from industry leaders
– Work alongside experts and innovators driving real change in security technology.
Drive meaningful impact
– Your work will directly contribute to pioneering security technologies that protect businesses and communities worldwide.
Advance your career
– Access professional development opportunities, including training programmes, mentorship and industry events.
Enjoy competitive rewards
– We offer a competitive compensation package, performance-based incentives and a comprehensive benefits programme that reflects your contributions.

Join the Future of Security

Acre offers the chance to be part of a fast-growing international business where you have the potential to grow, influence and make an impact. If you're ready to make a difference in a fast-moving, innovative industry, we'd love to hear from you.

Acre is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Hitachi Energy is a global leader in electrification, powering a sustainable future with innovative grid technologies and digital solutions. We’re inspiring the next era of sustainable energy, making electricity more accessible to all and empowering societies to thrive.

IVRS (Integration, Verification, Release and Support) is a department within Grid Integration Modular Advanced Control (GI MACH), working with securing the quality of the MACH platform, the brain of the HVDC station. We are responsible for verification of the MACH Platform towards high level requirements and for releasing the platform to our customers.

IVRS is developing a robust CI/CD pipeline to revolutionize delivery of the MACH platform in an HVDC project. Join the GI MACH team to help build a next-generation data platform that unifies data from diverse sources, creating a single source of truth for code development, design, and manufacturing.

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll play a pivotal role in automating and scaling the infrastructure that powers this platform, with extra focus on our internal applications and tools.

How You’ll Make An Impact

Design, develop, and implement mission-critical tools and applications to support a scalable, high-performance, high-volume production environment with global users.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for C++ and C# development environments, leveraging tools like Azure DevOps, MS Build scripts, Python and build systems.
Automate infrastructure and software processes using tools like Ansible or Terraform.
Manage containerized environments using Docker or Podman including creating and testing Windows and Linux images.
Implement full-stack monitoring and alerting systems using tools like Sensu, Splunk, Logstash or Nagios.
Plan and execute software and infrastructure upgrades based on data-driven capacity planning.
Manage configuration, variants, and version control using Git, TFVC, and release management tools like Jira.
Streamline development experiences for teams by designing scalable CI/CD processes and optimizing workflows with containerization and virtualization.
Collaborate with teams to support business needs and provide domain expertise for internal systems.

Your background

Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
Expert skills in Linux, networking, storage, and virtualization.
Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python. Shell and Golang beneficial.
Strong understanding of CI/CD processes and experience designing pipelines using GitHub or GitLab.
Familiarity with build systems (Makefiles, CMake) or Bazel and release management tools (e.g.: Git).
Ability to manage software and infrastructure upgrades with a focus on scalability and performance.
Experience setting up and supporting development environments for C++ and C#. Embedded system developer background beneficial.
Strong English communication skills, Swedish is advantage.

More About Us

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.

Our Benefits Offering For Our Roles Generally Includes

Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
Group life insurance and additional insurances.
Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
Health care and wellness allowance
Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
Psychological support program
Supplementary compensation for parental leave
Various trainings and education supporting employee development
Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to submit your application already today.

Questions can be directed to Talent Acquisition Partner Gustaf Hedström, gustaf.hedstrom@hitachienergy.com

jobs.title: Insurance Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Summary

We're looking for our first dedicated engineer for the insurance team - someone who wants to own the technical infrastructure behind how we price, analyze, and build insurance products. You'll build a truly great pricing engine, one that puts Lassie at the absolute top of the industry from a pricing perspective, and equip the insurance team with AI-powered analysis tooling and agents so they can move fast on pricing analysis and actuarial work without waiting on tech. Working closely with our tech team, you'll also contribute to projects across our insurance products more broadly - and to building something exceptional.

About Lassie

Pet parents have been stuck for too long with slow claims, confusing policies, and providers that treat their pet like a policy number instead of a member of the family. Lassie is the opposite: the go-to platform for managing every part of pet parenthood - health, insurance, payments, products, services and community - built around the pet and the people who love them. We've raised $75M in Series C, we're live in Sweden, Germany, France and the UK, and we're just getting started.

As a fast-growing scale-up, we hold ourselves to a high bar when it comes to our work: real ownership, fast execution, and decisions made like the business depends on them, because it does. Three values shape how we work:

Speed Machine - we move fast while others hesitate

Packed with Passion - we care deeply about our work and the pet parents we do it for

Copied Since 2021 - we don't follow trends, we create them.

We look for people who already work this way: people who care deeply, deliver fast, and want to help set the standard the rest of the industry ends up following.

Tasks

Own the pricing engine end to end: architecture, development, deployment, optimisation and maintenance

Build AI-powered analysis tooling and agents that let the insurance team move faster on pricing analysis and actuarial work, without waiting on tech

Build, improve and maintain high-frequency price updates, along with the monitoring and testing that let pricing changes ship fast with confidence, not risk

Act as the technical counterpart to our tech team from within the insurance team

Be scrappy and hands-on with whatever the work needs

Help set the bar for insurance engineering quality and how insurance engineering works at Lassie

Requirements

5+ years of experience as a developer, with a track record of owning systems end to end

Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or TypeScript, and comfortable working with data stores and warehouses like MongoDB and BigQuery

Fluent in English, both speaking and writing

Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills

Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Genuine analytical interest and drive for optimising pricing and winning customers

High ability for shipping and learning extraordinarily quickly

You take ownership without waiting to be told. You see what needs fixing and you fix it

Bonus: Experience with AWS

Work-model: This role is based in Stockholm, where we work 3 days per week at the office.

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Database Migration Service
jobs.description:
Description

Database Migration for Amazon RDS is fully managed, serverless capability that enables customers to migrate SQL Server/Oracle workloads - whether running on Amazon RDS, Amazon EC2, on-premises infrastructure, or other cloud providers - to Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Customers simply provide source and target connection details, and the service orchestrates the entire migration lifecycle end-to-end: pre-migration assessment, schema conversion, data movement.

In addition to a traditional console-driven experience, the service introduces an agentic migration workflow. Customers can initiate and manage migrations through natural language within the developer tools they already use - such as Kiro, Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex. The AI agent assesses the source environment, converts the schema, moves the data, validates the outcome - removing friction and reducing the expertise required to complete complex database migrations.

Amazon RDS is a part of AWS Utility Computing (UC) which provides product innovations - from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services

Key job responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, serverless microservices that power the migration lifecycle - assessment, schema conversion, data movement;
Develop intelligent, agent-driven migration workflows that integrate with modern developer tools and leverage natural language interfaces;
Own the end-to-end migration lifecycle - from pre-migration assessment and schema conversion through data movement phases;
Solve hard distributed systems challenges around reliability, security, and performance for customers migrating their most critical production workloads;
Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and AI/ML to deliver a seamless, low-friction migration experience that removes traditional barriers to database modernization;
Mentor SDE Is through code reviews, design guidance, and pair programming;
Participate in on-call rotations and operational excellence initiatives.

A day in the life

You might start the day with participating in a design review for a new feature: parallel data movement for multi-terabyte databases. You whiteboard trade-offs between consistency guarantees and throughput, debating how to minimize downtime during cutover windows. Later, you pair with a teammate to debug a race condition in the serverless orchestration layer that surfaces only under high concurrency.

About The Team

You'll join a team of curious, driven engineers who believe that technical excellence and world-class reliability are not aspirations - they are the baseline our customers deserve. If you want to build something that matters, alongside people who challenge and inspire you, this is the place.

This is a rare opportunity to design and operate systems at true cloud scale while developing deep expertise across three of the most transformative domains in modern engineering: cloud computing, database technologies, and artificial intelligence.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
Experience leading the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
Experience in professional, non-internship software development
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
Experience in development in the last 3 years

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations

Horizon Quantum's platform compiles and executes quantum programs on real quantum processors around the world. Every day, jobs flow through it: submitted, compiled, queued, run, returned. When one of those jobs fails, our engineers currently piece the story together from several systems at once.

You'll build the tool that fixes that. Over the course of the internship, a small team of interns will design and ship an internal operations platform that gives our Engineering and Support teams a single place to monitor the system, investigate failures, and act on live jobs. It will be used by the people sitting next to you, and it may still be in use after you go back to college.

About Horizon Quantum And Triple Alpha

Horizon Quantum is building software infrastructure that empowers developers to use quantum computing to solve the world’s toughest computational problems. Founded in 2018 by Dr. Joe Fitzsimons, a leading researcher, UCD alumnus and former professor with more than two decades of experience in quantum computing, the company is bridging the gap between today’s quantum hardware and tomorrow’s applications through the creation of advanced software development tools. Its integrated development environment, Triple Alpha, enables developers to write sophisticated, hardware-agnostic quantum programs at multiple levels of abstraction.

Built with proprietary Turing-complete languages and an optimizing compiler, Triple Alpha empowers developers to build complex hardware-agnostic quantum programs. In Triple Alpha, users can work at multiple levels of abstraction—from higher-level algorithm design to hardware-specific control.

Beyond higher-level programming tools, Triple Alpha gives developers access to advanced capabilities supported by Horizon’s underlying execution infrastructure. Users can code, compile, and optimize programs seamlessly across a range of processors and simulators, with built-in resource analysis and single-step API deployment.

What you'll build

A web application, backed by real services and real data, with the following at its core:

A searchable, filterable view of every job the platform has processed and the ability to drill into any one of them for the full picture.
Operational control and job management.
Integration between jobs and engineering tickets.
Live visibility into platform health and usage through dashboards and alerts.

How the internship runs

You'll work as a team, with our teams, and with a real degree of design authority and mentorship from our full time engineers throughout.

Requirements and investigation. Understand the existing system and its data model. Decide what's in scope and what isn't. Identify the constraints you're working within.
System design. Produce the architecture, including components and services, data flows, API specification, data access design, security and authorisation model, error handling, logging and monitoring, deployment, testing strategy. You'll present and defend this before writing production standard code.
Implementation. Build it, using the practices we use: Git, code review, issue tracking, automated testing, coding standards, separated environments, secure credential handling.
Testing. Unit, API, integration, frontend and end-to-end tests, covering the failure paths as seriously as the happy ones.
Documentation and handover. Architecture, local setup, deployment, configuration, API reference, troubleshooting, known limitations, and where you'd take it next.

You'll present your progress and findings to the wider Horizon Quantum team as you go.

What you'll come away with

A production system in use by professional engineers, and the story of how you designed it.
Full-stack experience, including frontend, services, APIs, data, integrations, observability, and deployment.
Practice at the parts of engineering that courses rarely teach, such as scoping ambiguous requirements, defending an architecture, writing documentation someone else needs, and building something secure enough to point at production.
A working understanding of how a commercial quantum computing platform actually operates.
Colleagues and a network in one of the most interesting corners of today’s technology industry.

Who we're looking for

You don't need a quantum computing background. You need to be a capable software engineer who wants to be challenged.

We're looking for:

Students in the final year of a computer science, software engineering or related degree, or on a master's programme
Solid programming ability in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, or a comparable language
Familiarity with web application development and relational databases
The instinct to ask what a system is really for before building it
Clear communication, including in writing
Self-direction, and the follow-through to finish what you start

Useful, not essential:

React, FastAPI or PostgreSQL specifically
Experience with REST API design, testing frameworks, Docker or CI/CD
Any prior exposure to production systems, monitoring or on-call work
Curiosity about quantum computing (the interest matters more than the knowledge)

Practicalities

Location: Our offices, Dublin 2, Ireland. This is an on-site internship.
Duration: 7 months, February to August 2027.
Paid: Yes. €2100 per month.

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. Our team is looking for a highly motivated Systems Development Engineer in Amazon Security who will raise the security bar by delivering industry-best security services. You should be somebody who enjoys inventing and simplifying around complex security challenges, obsesses over the customer experience, and feels strongly about delivering results. You should be passionate about solving security hurdles in innovative ways. We do not desire to simply produce good software here at Amazon Security... we want to produce disruptive, industry-leading innovations.

Key job responsibilities

Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers and customers make billions of transactions worldwide on our cloud and the Amazon retail site. The Amazon Security team owns security for all of these services offered by Amazon Security, including EC2, S3, and many others, as well as the security of our global retail sites. This team is an EU-based Operations team, integrated with Software Development teams, supporting Amazon Foundational Security Services, to provide our customers with secure by default security services. We dive deep into security technologies such as new access control design patterns, identity security services, access control, authorization, authentication, and life cycle management to support our customers as Amazon continues to scale and grow. We are looking for software professionals from diverse backgrounds, who are creative problem solvers, and passionate about delivering solutions that improve both user experience and security. We are a global team and have a culture of learning from each other. We don’t expect people to join our team knowing everything. We want people who are excited to learn, to challenge the status quo, and who are energized by building highly scalable and available systems on a global scale.

The EUSC Operations team runs a 24/7/365 operation, and on-call support will be required as part of this role. You would join the on-call rotation approximately once every 4–6 weeks.

Our team values work-life harmony. Being part of a 24/7/365 on-call rotation is an important aspect of maintaining operational excellence in this role, and we understand that striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here. On-call rotations are structured to be manageable — occurring roughly once every 4–6 weeks — so that you can stay engaged and effective without feeling overburdened. We encourage members of the team to use personal time as needed to cultivate this balance and to promote a productive and well-balanced life — both in and outside of work.

Amazon has a fast-paced environment - “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” Our team works with users to design new security features, deploy software through large automated systems, and operationally support security software. We offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and balanced life—both in and outside of work.

jobs.description:
Vi er på utkikk etter flere dedikerte systemutviklere som kan utvikle innovative løsninger for kundene våre.

Våre avdelinger i Ålesund og Ørsta er nordvestlandets største konsulentmiljø. Vi tør påstå at vi har regionens mest spennende kunder, og langvarige relasjoner som sikrer stadig påfyll av utviklende prosjekter. Sammen med våre 2500 kollegaer i Twoday får du muligheten til å jobbe på Sunnmøre, med nasjonale kunder av alle størrelser. Her er et lite utvalg av det vi gjør:

Fremtidens skip: Sammen med VARD jobber vi med å forberede avanserte skip for fjernstyring og autonom kjøring.
Utdeling av samfunnsbidrag: Vi jobber sammen med Sparebanken Møre for å effektivisere prosessen der lag og foreninger kan søke om å få tildelt støtte til samfunnsnyttige bidrag.
Sjøsikkerhet: For Kystverket analyserer vi data om skipstrafikk, vær & sjøforhold, og hjelper dermed å holde havområdene våre trygge.

Vi ser etter deg som har:

Minimum 5 års relevant erfaring. Det er en fordel om du har vært konsulent tidligere, men ikke et krav.
Kompetanse innen enten backendutvikling med .NET/C# eller Java, eller frontendutvikling med erfaring fra moderne rammeverk og teknologier.
Erfaring med skybaserte løsninger i AWS og/eller Azure.
Du bruker AI aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet og er nysgjerrig på hvordan teknologien kan omsettes til konkrete kundeløsninger.
Det er også supert om du har erfaring med smidig arbeidsmetodikk, automatisering av bygg og testing.
Gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.

Hvorfor Twoday?

I Twoday jobber du sammen med flinke folk som bryr seg, både om faget og om hverandre. Vi er rause i måten vi samarbeider på, det er lav terskel for å spørre om hjelp, utfordre ideer og lære underveis. Trivsel hos oss handler ikke bare om spennende oppdrag, men om å være del av et miljø der folk blir værende over tid. I dag er 35 % av kollegene våre og over halvparten av lederne kvinner. Dette er vi stolte av i en bransje som ofte ser annerledes ut.

Du blir en del av et bredt og inkluderende fagmiljø med aktiv kunnskapsdeling på tvers av teamene i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Finland og Litauen. Vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling gjennom faggrupper, fagkvelder, kurs og sertifiseringer. Hos oss skal det også være mulig å vokse over tid, og å ta initiativ utover eget ansvarsområde. Det kan være innen fagansvar, arkitektur, team- eller teknologiledelse, eller i mer tverrfaglige og globale roller.

Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige betingelser, fleksibilitet i arbeidshverdagen og høy grad av tillit. Du får rom til å styre egen hverdag innenfor teamets og kundens rammer, mulighet for Hive Jumping mellom et av våre kontorer i våre fem land, og mulighet for medeierskap i selskapet. Hos oss skal det være mulig å gjøre en god jobb og samtidig ha et godt liv ved siden av.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Vi tar gjerne en prat, uavhengig av om du aktivt er på jobbsøk eller bare er nysgjerrig på å høre mer om hvordan vi jobber og hva vi kan tilby.

Oppfyller du ikke alle kravene nevnt ovenfor?

I Twoday ønsker vi å skape et arbeidsmiljø der folk føler seg velkomne og trygge på å være seg selv. Hvis denne rollen høres interessant ut for deg, men du ikke kjenner deg igjen i absolutt alle punktene i stillingsbeskrivelsen, oppfordrer vi deg likevel til å ta kontakt eller sende inn en søknad.

jobs.title: Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM (frontend/backend udvikler) - genopslag
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
I Clever arbejder vi for en verden, der kører på el. Lige nu har vi brug for dig, der vil være med til at bygge og udvikle Dynamics 365 CRM-løsninger, som er med til at gøre det nemmere for vores kunder at vælge el i hverdagen.

Din rolle

Rollen er en frontend-udvikler med forståelse for backend udvikling. En rolle, der har et ben i begge lejre, som vil være med til at bygge og sætte retningslinjer for udviklingskomponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

Vi drømmer om dig, der vil være med til at bygge centrale komponenter med mange aftagere. Vi arbejder med et system, der er bredt anvendt og hyppigt videreudvikles, så du vil indgå i dialoger med mange interne interessenter. Med andre ord er de rammer, vi sætter i CRM-platform teamet ikke kun vigtige for os, men også for andre udviklingsteams’ arbejde med platformen. Konkret vil du operere med frontend komponenter i Microsoft Dynamics CRM.

I dagligdagen anvender vi PCF, typescript og custom pages mv. for at understøtte forretningens processer i CRM.

Hos os har vi ikke klassiske titler. Vi har profiler. Når vi kalder rollen ”frontend-udvikler”, er det, så du og resten af verden ved, hvem vi leder efter. Men når du starter hos os, bliver din profil ”Ansvarlig for udvikling i Dynamics 365 CRM” – for det er netop det, du er.

Din hverdag

Din hverdag vil blandt andet være fyldt med:

Udvikling af React, Typescript-baserede komponenter og custom pages i CRM.
Dialoger om optimal anvendelse af teknologi og principper inden for udvikling
Planlægning af projekter
Monitorering og drift af vores systemer
Samarbejde med fagligt stærke og hjælpsomme kollegaer, der alle har samme mål for øje

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har god erfaring med React og Typescript, og at du har arbejdet med Dynamics CRM før. Du har prøvet at bygge centrale systemer med mange aftagere, hvor du har mærket, hvad der skal til for, at de fremstår robuste og vedligeholdelsesvenlige.

Erfaring med udvikling af frontend-komponenter i Dynamics CRM
Brænder for gode UI/UX-oplevelser i Dynamics CRM
Erfaring med React eller andet frontend framework
Erfaring med integrationer og kommunikation mellem systemer
Erfaring med C# og .Net og forståelse for backend-udvikling er et plus

Hvem bliver dine legekammerater?

Du vil blive en del af CRM-platform teamet , hvor vi arbejder tæt sammen, og derfor primært befinder os på vores kontor.

Vi er seks fuldtidsansatte og en studentermedhjælper. Det vil sige en platforms- og strategiansvarlig, to Dynamics platformsspecialister, en koordinator, en release manager samt vores cloudarkitekt- og backendudvikler. Dine tætteste kollegaer vil primært være i dit eget team, men vi arbejder også tæt sammen med et andet CRM-team.

Derudover er der gode muligheder for at skabe netværk og samarbejde med andre frontend-udviklere i Clever.

Medledelseskompetencer (vi er nemlig organiseret anderledes)  

Du tager naturligt ansvar for både dig selv og dine kollegaer, med omsorg og nærvær  
Du er en holdspiller, der ser arbejde som et samarbejde, ikke en konkurrence  
Du holder dit ego i skak og ved, at succes handler om at løfte i flok mod fælles mål 

Har du sat mentale flueben hele vejen igennem?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Finder vi det rette match, kan vi finde på at lukke opslaget før fristen. Så hvis du tænker, at det her job er det rigtige for dig, så send din ansøgning allerede i dag, så du er sikker på at komme i betragtning. Vi håber, at vi gennem din ansøgning kan lære dig at kende og se, hvad du kan bidrage med. Det er fint, hvis du bruger AI-værktøjer til inspiration – men husk at personliggøre din ansøgning, da vi leder efter hele mennesker. Vi modtager kun ansøgninger igennem vores hjemmeside.

Du kan læse mere om, hvordan det er at arbejde hos os på: www.clever.dk/velkommen eller vores Instagramkonto @liveticlever. Er du nysgerrig på vores rekrutteringsproces kan du læse mere om den her: Rekrutteringsprocessen i Clever | Clever .

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Computerized Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Department

IT & Automation, Drug Substance Manufacturing, Global Manufacturing & Supply

Location

Kalundborg, Denmark. Your main base is close to the manufacturing sites. Travel to partner locations in the Copenhagen area may occur on an ad hoc basis but is not a regular work location.

Your impact begins here

As a Computerized Systems Engineer, you keep the computerized equipment, smart instruments and IT/OT systems behind large-scale drug substance production running reliably and in a validated, GMP-compliant state. Your work supports consistent, stable operations that colleagues in production depend on every day—helping ensure the medicines people living with serious chronic diseases rely on can be made safely and on time.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a proactive, collaborative colleague who is eager to develop within computerized systems, digital manufacturing and IT/OT support in a GMP-regulated environment.

Essential

A B.Sc., M.Sc., AP Degree or similar within IT, Engineering, Automation, Instrumentation, Computer Science or a related technical field.
Full professional proficiency in English, written and spoken.
An interest in learning GMP requirements and maintaining systems in a validated environment.
A structured, solution-oriented approach, ownership of your tasks and genuine enjoyment of working with different stakeholders.

Useful, But Not Essential

Experience from IT, automation, instrumentation, manufacturing support, laboratory systems or technical support functions. Recent graduates with relevant internships, student jobs or project work are also encouraged to apply.
Knowledge of manufacturing processes or experience from a regulated industry.
Experience with incident and change management, user administration, system maintenance, SOPs, backup and recovery, or supplier coordination.
Familiarity with validation, data integrity, IT security, risk assessments, infrastructure or computerized systems lifecycle management.

What You'll Do

You'll help secure reliable, compliant operations across production by maintaining the systems that keep manufacturing moving. In practice, you will:

Maintain and support computerized equipment, smart instruments and related IT components to ensure availability, reliability and operational stability.
Contribute to ongoing process validation (OPV) and periodic reviews, and manage Operation and Maintenance SOPs through their full lifecycle.
Support incident, problem, deviation and change management, and coordinate patching, upgrades, backup, recovery, restore planning and user access in line with quality and validation requirements.
Identify IT and computerized equipment risks and complete IT risk assessments covering security, data integrity, infrastructure, coding/configuration, smart instruments and operational support.
Safeguard data integrity for electronic data generated, processed, stored or transferred by computerized equipment and smart instruments.

Who You'll Work With

You'll join the IT & Automation Department—a diverse team of colleagues from many nationalities and professional backgrounds. The atmosphere is inclusive and collaborative: people support each other in finding answers and share the load across tasks. Because project life moves fast, the team is dynamic and ready to shift priorities to hit important milestones.

You'll work closely with stakeholders across manufacturing, quality and validation in Kalundborg, and with collaboration partners based around Copenhagen. Together, you'll keep the project running with clarity and speed.

What You Can Expect Here

You'll work in one of the strongest IT and Automation environments in the pharmaceutical industry, with real scope to build new skills across computerized systems, digital manufacturing and GMP-regulated IT/OT support. Whether you're an experienced engineer or a recent graduate, you'll be trusted to take ownership, encouraged to make your voice heard and supported to grow.

At Novo, you’ll join a global healthcare company with a unique culture and strong results. We offer continuous learning, career development, and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: For this role, the annual base salary ranges from DKK 499,600 to DKK 734,400 corresponding to the level of the position. The role is open to candidates with varying levels of experience, and placement within the range is assessed during recruitment based on your skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you're ready to keep large-scale drug substance production running reliably and compliantly, apply for the Computerized Systems Engineer role by 23 September 2026.

For further information about the position, please contact Tinne Bonde at THEB@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.
