Senior Gameplay Programmer on WHAT THE CAR?

Do you love working in small, creative teams turning wild ideas into a reality? What about having creative and technical ownership from ideation through to release? Read on!

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.

WHAT THE CAR? is our absurdly silly racing adventure game which addresses fundamental questions such as… What if a car had legs? Or a jetpack? Or secretly identified as a sailboat? First launched in 2023 on Apple Arcade and now also on Steam, it has gained a steady following of dedicated fans who have contributed hundreds of thousands of community-built levels.

We’re looking for a Senior Gameplay Programmer to help us continue to build upon CAR’s success by expanding upon its absurdly silly universe! We believe the best people to come up with ideas are the ones implementing them, so we expect a high degree of creativity and game design knowledge from our Gameplay Programmers, in addition to their crazy tech skills. This role involves around 60% programming and 40% game design.

Here’s What That Looks Like Day To Day

Build and ship gameplay code. You’ll implement features end-to-end in an existing Unity/C# codebase and ship regularly in a live environment.
Generate design ideas. You’ll take part in shaping features, articulate intent, evaluate tradeoffs, and iterate through discussion with the team.
Keep the game healthy. Fix bugs, improve systems, review test videos, and document findings so issues don’t come back to haunt us.
Extend and refine what’s there. You’ll build on existing mechanics, making them more robust and enjoyable for players.
Support and collaborate. You’re part of a small, closely knit, cross discipline team where people help each other reach their goals.
Prototype and let go. Not everything ships, and that’s fine. Comfort with iteration and refactoring is part of the job.

You’re a great match if

You have 8+ years of commercial game development experience, having shipped at least two games as part of a team
You have strong Unity and C# skills. You’re comfortable navigating a shared codebase and writing maintainable code you’d be proud to hand off
You care about stability, performance, and long-term maintainability, and you leave systems better than you found them
You genuinely value collaboration and working very closely with every member of the team
You approach other people’s ideas with openness and try to understand the intention before giving feedback or pushing back

Nice to have

Experience working on live games

Requirements For Any Job At Triband

You thrive in taking ownership - you spot problems, design and implement creative solutions that push projects forward
You’re motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness, and creativity, and you actively contribute to sustaining that culture
You value a positive work environment
You contribute to making the studio a fun and supportive place

Practicalities

Primarily work on-site at our cozy office in central Copenhagen
Only open to candidates who are already eligible to work in Denmark as we don’t offer relocation support or visa sponsorship for this role
37-hour work week, with flexible work hours
No crunch, we put people before deadlines
Our working language is English

We offer

Silly but ambitious projects
The chance to contribute to great games that reach millions of players
A playful and ambitious work environment where experimentation is encouraged
Friendly and kind colleagues who love making each other laugh as much as making games
A professional development budget to invest in your growth
Social activities like Friday bars, hobby nights, board game nights and team events
Daily lunch at a local restaurant just a walk across the lakes away, with plant-based options (and soft ice on Thursdays).
Six weeks of paid vacation
Paid parental leave at full salary for the periods covered by state reimbursement
Child's first sick day on us, no questions asked
Pension plan and private health insurance
Endless amounts of coffee

WHAT THE TRIBAND?

Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, which is played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 50 wonderful humans are united by our mission to make everyone laugh. To do so, we focus on exploring comedy through gameplay. We like to break player expectations, use wonderful music, slick art, and create a quirky atmosphere. We experiment a lot, and it doesn’t always work out, but we always learn something.

We put people first and strive to create a safe and creative working environment. We believe that teams, not individuals, make games - and we believe diversity makes for better teams. For these reasons, we look for people who bring new perspectives and will challenge us and our way of doing things.

Udvikle case management applikationer: processer og services, der understøtter konkrete forretningsprocesser.
Designe og implementere integrationer til Nykredit-koncernens øvrige systemer.
Bygge robuste REST-API’er og arbejde med datahåndtering (fx via Hibernate/JPA eller direkte mod databaser).
Sikre kvalitet i kode og løsninger gennem gode udviklingsmønstre, genbrug, code reviews og test.
Sparre tæt med product owners, proceskonsulenter, arkitekter og andre udviklere om design af løsninger – fra første skitse til drift.

tænker i skalerbare, vedligeholdbare løsninger og går op i kvalitet, sikkerhed og performance.

Til gengæld lover vi både udvikling og muligheder til dig, der vil og kan.

Build: pipeline: GitHub Actions.

SAST/SCA: SonarQube, Snyk/GitHub Advanced Security.

Job Description

Design and implement workflow‑based control automation for Regulatory Standards (e.g., ISO, PCI) and SOX 404 ITGCs, using:
Explicit start–action–evidence–end flows.
Triggers from tickets, change‑management systems, HR events, or IAM changes.
Delivered via tools such as n8n, Camunda, Azure Logic Apps, or custom MCP‑style servers.

Build and operate MCP‑style or MCP‑compatible servers that expose:
Tools: RESTful endpoints for “trigger evidence collection”, “run access review”, “validate change ticket”, etc..
Resources: Standardized data sources (logs, IAM, ticket data) formatted for AI agents or workflow engines.
Auth patterns: API keys, bearer tokens, OAuth2, or OIDC‑style flows that can be consumed by agents or external tools.

Engineer API‑first automation:
Write scripts and connectors (Python, Node.js, Bash, etc.) that call, compose, and orchestrate APIs from:
IAM, IdP, PAM, HRIS, ticketing, cloud IAM, and logging platforms, etc.
GRC platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar) via REST APIs.

Implement:
Authentication and authorization (API keys, Bearer, OAuth2, JWT, Basic, MTLS).
Pagination, retry with backoff, rate‑limiting, and safe error handling.
Idempotency and safe state transitions for audit‑critical operations.

Translate ISO 27001 controls and SOX 404 ITGCs into automated workflows:
Example pattern:
Trigger: new user join or role change in IAM.
Action: call APIs to validate entitlements, cross‑check against SoD, and emit evidence to a GRC tool.
Outcome: workflow‑generated record for ISO 27001 access control and SOX logical‑access control.

Maintain one source of truth for control logic (code / config) and use workflow IDs as control‑evidence bindings.

Design AI‑agent‑ready interfaces:
Expose structured, MCP‑style endpoints or OpenAPI specs so that LLM agents or workflow tools can call concrete tools (e.g., “get latest access review for System X”, “run change‑ticket‑completeness check”).
Handle dynamic policy enforcement: short‑lived tokens, context‑aware access, and audit logging for each AI or agent call.

Integrate with data platforms and SIEM/logging:
Use logs, change tickets, and identity events as workflow inputs.
Build automated tests for control effectiveness (e.g., “if a production change is not approved, fire an alert and record as control failure”) linked to ISO / SOX control IDs.

Maintain audit‑ready workflow artifacts:
Log all workflow steps, including timestamps, input, user/agent context, and outputs.
Ensure workflow outputs are machinable (JSON, structured logs) and can be replayed or reasoned over by auditors or AI agents.

Requirements

Students currently pursuing Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering or related disciplines.
Strong understanding of authorization and authentication:
API keys, Bearer tokens, OAuth2 (client, JWT, PKCE), Basic Auth, MTLS, and OIDC‑style flows.
Hands‑on experience implementing these in Python, Node.js, or Go (or similar).

Deep practical experience with:
RESTful APIs: understanding of HTTP methods, status codes, pagination, rate‑limiting, and idempotency.
API clients: writing or using libraries that handle auth, retries, and error handling for large datasets.

Experience building or integrating with:
Workflow / orchestration tools (n8n, Airflow, Logic Apps, Camunda, etc.) or MCP‑style servers / Model Context Protocol‑compatible tooling.
GRC platforms via APIs (e.g., ServiceNow, 6clicks, or similar).

Familiarity with:
ISO 27001 (especially Annex A controls related to access management, change control, and operations).
SOX 404 ITGCs (logical access, change management, computer operations, data integrity).

Full-time interns preferred
Part-time interns who can commit at least 3 working days a week are also welcome to apply

Preferred Qualifications

OpenAPI / Swagger to MCP‑style tool generation (e.g., converting production APIs into MCP servers or AI‑agent tools).
Experience with MCP servers or similar control‑plane architectures that expose tools, resources, and prompts for AI agents.
Background in security automation, CI/CD, or DevSecOps (number of tools: n8n, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, logging pipelines).

We are looking for a passionate and motivated Software Development Engineer I to join the Product Data Management (PDM) engineering team in Singapore.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

nShift
is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

We are seeking a dynamic and accomplished .NET Developer to join our talented Portal team. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of technical expertise in modern .NET development, frontend skills, and a passion for working with cutting-edge AI technology. As a key player in our organization, you should have a proven track record of delivering high-quality software, building scalable systems, and continuously learning new technologies.

Purpose of role

In the Portal, we're building innovative User Management, Identity Provider, SCIM solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to an active, growing AI platform and expand its capabilities through practical, hands-on development.

We are looking for a practical, hands-on developer who will help us build, improve, and extend the chat system by implementing real features using established libraries and modern best practices.

No prior AI/LLM experience required
- we're looking for strong software engineers who are excited to learn and work with cutting-edge AI technology. If you have solid engineering fundamentals and curiosity about AI, we'll help you develop the AI-specific skills.

Your role includes:

Building and maintaining both backend (.NET) and frontend (VUE/React/TypeScript) components
Implementing AI agent features and LLM integrations using established frameworks
Developing real-time streaming conversation systems
Creating document ingestion and processing pipelines
Contributing to technical decisions and architectural improvements
Collaborating with Product Managers and the engineering team to deliver high-quality features

What You'll Be Doing

Technology

Build and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient .NET code
Develop responsive React applications with TypeScript and modern frontend practices
Integrate with multiple LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)
Implement real-time streaming systems using WebSocket/SSE
Work with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns
Ensure code quality through testing, type hints, and code reviews
Keep the technology stack up to date and follow best practices

Process

Follow established development processes and advocate for continuous improvement
Write clean, well-documented code with comprehensive tests
Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions
Use modern development tools and practices (Git, Docker, CI/CD)
Challenge yourself and the team to enhance working methods
Contribute to technical documentation and internal education

Collaboration

Work closely with other developers, product managers, and stakeholders
Participate in planning and architectural discussions
Share knowledge and mentor team members on technical topics
Communicate effectively in English (written and spoken)
Take ownership of features from design to deployment

What You Will Bring

For the role of Software Engineer in our Portal team at nShift, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency
: Strong hands-on experience with .NET. Experience with API design, database optimization, and system architecture thinking is essential. Experience with LLMs, AI agent frameworks, vector databases and TypeScript is a distinct advantage, but not mandatory - these can be learned on the job.

Problem-Solving Ability
: You have strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Learning Mindset
: Genuine curiosity about AI/ML and eagerness to learn new technologies. You are comfortable reading documentation and learning new frameworks quickly.

Quality Focus
: You maintain high standards in code quality, testing, and software craftsmanship. You understand the importance of writing maintainable, well-tested code.

Effective Communication
: Proficiency in both written and spoken English is essential for ensuring seamless communication within the team and with stakeholders.

Ownership Mindset
: You take responsibility for your work, follow through on commitments, and care about delivering value to users.

Requirements

Competence and Experience

Must Have

5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong .NET
Solid AWS knowledge
React and TypeScript proficiency
RESTful APIs, WebSockets, streaming responses
PostgreSQL and SQL optimization
Docker and Kubernetes fundamentals
Git and code review practices

Preferred (Nice To Have)

Any experience with LLMs (personal projects, side projects, API integrations)
AI agent frameworks (LangChain)
Vector databases (PostgreSQL with pgvector, OpenSearch)
Document processing and OCR
AWS services (Bedrock, S3, EKS)
Experience with real-time data processing

Education

Professional growth from engineer to AI platform specialist

Could that be you?

Your mission

As a Software Engineer II, you will design, build, and improve reliable cloud services that power critical automation capabilities across the UiPath platform. You will work on backend systems that need to scale, perform consistently, integrate with other platform services, and support customers across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments.

Design, develop, test, and maintain backend and cloud-native services used across the UiPath platform.
Build scalable, secure, reliable, and high-performing distributed systems, with a focus on long-term maintainability.

jobs.title: Java Developer with Angular
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Adobe Experience Platform powers real-time customer experiences for the world’s largest enterprises — unifying data, resolving identity at scale, orchestrating journeys, and activating audiences across every channel. Behind these capabilities are engineering teams that must understand both the platform’s architecture and the regulated, complex environments where customers operate.

The FDE role sits at the intersection of solution architecture, technical consulting, and hands-on engineering. You will be embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA customers — working directly with their teams to solve complex platform challenges, design scalable architectures, and build what’s needed to unblock adoption and expansion.

This is not a support role. You don’t wait for tickets. You operate inside cross-functional Customer Pods — small, autonomous teams with end-to-end ownership — translating customer problems into working platform solutions. You lead with architecture, prototype rapidly, and close the gap between what customers need and what the platform delivers.

What You’ll Do

Partner directly with strategic customers to understand their architecture, workflows, security requirements, and business objectives
Translate complex customer problems into scalable solution designs, reference architectures, and working prototypes
Investigate and troubleshoot production-level platform issues — from data ingestion and identity resolution to journey orchestration and audience activation
Design and validate end-to-end enterprise solutions spanning AEP, RTCDP, AJO, and adjacent Adobe systems
Lead architecture workshops, health checks, and technical deep-dives that earn customer trust before any commercial motion
Rapidly prototype, experiment, and iterate on new capabilities — using AI-assisted tools as a standard part of execution
Bridge the gap between customer needs, product direction, and engineering implementation — feeding field patterns back into the product roadmap
Own the technical relationship with assigned accounts — from initial discovery through implementation, go-live, and expansion

What Succes Looks Like

We hire for demonstrated impact, not credential accumulation. Strong candidates will show:

Customer-to-Solution Thinking — you connect customer problems, workflows, and business goals with practical technical solutions — collapsing the gap between requirement and working platform capability
Architecture with Execution — you don’t just design; you prototype, validate, debug, and iterate. Your architectures work because you’ve built them, not just drawn them
Production Awareness — you understand how distributed systems behave at scale — data integrity, graceful degradation, and observability are part of how you think, not afterthoughts
Enterprise Navigation — you operate across complex organizational boundaries, regulatory constraints, and multi-stakeholder environments with confidence and credibility
AI-Augmented Execution — you use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a standard part of how you design, prototype, and deliver
Adaptability Under Ambiguity — you navigate evolving environments where experimentation, learning, and iteration are core to the process — and you don’t mistake seniority for certainty

Typical background: 8–15+ years across solution architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing engineering roles. What matters is what that experience has produced — not the title or the number of years.

Your Domain

AEP / RTCDP / AJO: Adobe’s core platform — data ingestion, segmentation, journey orchestration, audience activation
Enterprise Architecture: Multi-system integration, data flows, identity resolution, API design across complex landscapes
Security & Compliance: Regulated industries (FSI, Healthcare), data sovereignty, privacy-preserving architectures, GDPR
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure — infrastructure patterns, managed services, networking
Data Platforms: Event-driven architectures, streaming pipelines, batch processing, data lakes
Observability: Platform health, SLO definition, performance governance, production monitoring

What We Value

Beyond technical execution, the people who grow fastest on this team demonstrate:

Agency - You identify problems before they are assigned to you and drive them to resolution
Product Judgment - You understand what the platform needs to do for customers, not just what the ticket says to build
Customer Empathy -You earn trust by understanding the customer’s world — their constraints, pressures, and what success looks like for them
Builder Mindset - You are as comfortable prototyping a new capability as you are presenting an architecture to a CT

Nice to Have
:

Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud products (AEP, AJO, RTCDP, CJA, Target)
Experience with similar platforms - CDP, MDM, martech, or data platforms
Background in regulated industries (Financial Services, Healthcare, Government) and familiarity with their compliance and security constraints
Experience with data governance, privacy-preserving computation, or secure data collaboration patterns
Familiarity with identity resolution or customer data unification systems
Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, Step Functions, or similar)
Track record of driving architecture decisions or technical strategy at team or org level

Why This Team

Work on complex enterprise problems with direct customer impact — your solutions go live in production, not in slide decks
Operate inside autonomous, cross-functional Pods embedded with Adobe’s most strategic EMEA accounts
Combine architecture, strategy, engineering, and customer engagement in a single role — no two weeks look the same
Shape a new engineering engagement model centered around rapid experimentation and AI-assisted execution
Collaborate with experienced engineers across Adobe’s global platform teams
Build engineering credibility that earns expansion rights — from workshops to FDE to renewals

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.

Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.

.

Support security testing and approval activities.
Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.

.
Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.

JavaScript and HTML.

.

for automation, ETL and data analysis.

experience

Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer - Flutter, .NET & Connected Devices (SMARTLINK IoT Mobile)
jobs.description:
Your role

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem - commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert - so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet - flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.

You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.

You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.

You move between product discussions, Flutter development, backend services, APIs design and implementation, analytics and troubleshooting. One day is user journeys with the Product Owner and designer; the next is a Flutter feature, an ASP.NET Core endpoint, or working out from Mixpanel why a commissioning flow is being abandoned at step three.

You will be comfortable in a codebase with history and constraints, and you care as much about the problem as the solution - what frustrates the user in the field is as interesting to you as the architecture behind it.

In This Role, You Will

Build new capabilities for SMARTLINK Mobile in Flutter and Dart, and extend ASP.NET Core services and APIs behind them - owning a capability end to end rather than one side of it.
Take part in discovery and refinement: understand the persona and the journey, apply jobs-to-be-done thinking, and challenge a requirement before it is built rather than after.
Work with the Product Owner and designer from the first sketch, and say so when a flow does not hold once real devices and real field conditions are involved.
Build the commissioning and onboarding experiences for sensors, gateways and connected equipment.
Engineer for the field: intermittent connectivity, offline behaviour, slow networks, and failure states that tell the user what to do next instead of what went wrong.
Close the loop with data: adoption and usage in Mixpanel, system behaviour in New Relic, and commissioning success and failure rates treated as a first-class product metric.
Keep quality where it belongs: tests alongside the product code, code review, architecture discussions, and your share of production troubleshooting.
Leverage AI in your daily work and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

You have built and shipped a mobile or fullstack product that other people depend on - not a greenfield demo, but something with history, users and constraints. You can tell the difference between a flow that is finished and one that merely works, and you are as comfortable in a product conversation as in a stack trace. We need you to hit the ground running: come in as a solid medior and grow into owning a significant part of the mobile product, or arrive senior and set the patterns the team adopts.

Your Profile Includes

Several years of hands-on software development, at a level where you own a feature end to end: design, implementation, data, and the edge cases in between.
Strong C# and .NET, including REST APIs and backend services you have designed rather than only consumed.
Production Flutter and Dart experience - an app that real users depend on, not a demo.
Modern engineering as a habit: testing next to the product code, code review, CI/CD, and a build setup you understand.
Strong analytical and root cause skills. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Comfortable in a multidisciplinary agile team, with the confidence to say in refinement that something should not be built the way it is specified.
Fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Genuine interest in UX and product discovery - you want to understand how the user works, not just what to build.
Bluetooth Low Energy, WiFi provisioning or device onboarding development.
Connected devices, sensors and gateways, or industrial IoT more broadly.
Offline-first mobile applications and mobile performance work.
Analytics and observability in practice: Mixpanel, New Relic, feature flags, A/B testing.
Azure, event-driven architectures and microservices.
Firmware update workflows.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees’ development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, you will also have access to global career opportunities. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

With operations in 68 countries, our 22,000 enterprising people work collaboratively to provide expert advice to maximize the potential of property and real assets to accelerate the success of our clients, our investors and our people.

For more than 29 years, Colliers has created value for shareholders that has resulted in superior returns and industry growth. Our people also own significant equity in our business, which brings pride of ownership to everything we do. We are passionate, take personal responsibility and always do what's right for our clients, people and communities.

Job Description

Reporting into Manager, Software Engineering, the Backend Engineer will work within the Global Technology Hub from our Madrid office.

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Backend Engineer
for our newly established Technology Hub
in Madrid. This is a unique opportunity to become part of the founding team that helps shape the culture, practices, and technical direction. Working in a hybrid model
(remote & onsite), you will enjoy significant freedom to innovate and influence
the future of one of the world’s largest commercial real estate companies. With the leadership of the Global Technology Hub coming from a background of technology startups, you will benefit from a fast-paced learning environment, high visibility of your contributions and opportunities to shape processes, culture and technology strategies. At the same time, you take advantage of the stability, resources, and reach of a successful global company
.

Guided by our global digital strategy, the Madrid Hub collaborates closely with international teams to deliver world-class technology solutions
that power the future of commercial real estate.

As Backend Engineer
, you specialize in .Net, and will play a key role in designing, developing and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performance enterprise software solutions. You will contribute to global products and platforms that serve both internal and external customers in Commercial Real Estate across multiple regions. Working closely with international Product, Engineering, DevOps, Data, QA and Architecture teams, you will ensure delivery excellence, software quality and great customer experience.

Essential Functions And Job Duties

Software Development and Design

Implement scalable and maintainable B2B software products using the Microsoft .NET stack (C#, ASP.NET Core)
Contribute to architecture discussions/technology evaluation and participate in system and code reviews.
Help define and adhere to coding standards, documentation and modern software lifecycle best practices, such as SOLID principles, unit testing, CI/CD, and secure coding
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA to translate business requirements into technical specifications and user stories.
Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement and feature grooming to ensure technical feasibility and shared understanding across disciplines

Technical Leadership Alignment

Identify opportunities for technical improvements and advocate for high-quality engineering standards
Participate in design and code review sessions to uphold engineering excellence across the team
Take on technical ownership of production systems
Continuous improvement of agile methodologies and tools

Quality and Performance

Drive culture of test-first development with unit, integration and performance testing
Support root cause analysis and resolution of production issues, ensuring high reliability and uptime
Contribute to ongoing platform refactoring and modernization efforts.

Global Collaboration

Work closely with DevOps and Engineering Operations teams to optimize build pipelines, observability and deployment automation.
Ensure compliance with global standards, information security policies and regulatory requirements
Collaborate regularly with Product Teams, especially Product Owners, to align on requirements, clarify priorities and deliver business value iteratively.

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

5+ years of experience in .NET software development with C# and ASP.NET Core.
Strong knowledge of object-oriented design, microservices architecture and API development (REST/GraphQL)
Experience with SQL and NOSQL databases (e.g. SQL Server or Postgres SQL, Cosmos DB, MongoDB), as well as caching with Redis or similar.
Advanced understanding of cloud-native architectures, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (preferably GCP)
Experience in containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
Agile Development experience (Scrum/Kanban), including story estimation, code reviews and pair programming.
Experience working in distributed or remote teams and using tools such as Jira, GitHub, Miro and Azure DevOps.
Solid understanding of performance optimization.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, fluent in English and Spanish.
Passionate about building high-quality software products with empowered teams.
Understanding of secure development practices and compliance frameworks (e.g. ISO27001, GDPR, SOC2).

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience in working in a global, multi-cultural organization.
Exposure to domain-driven design (DDD) and event-driven architecture.
Experience with observability tools (e.g. Sentry, Lighthouse etc.)
Ability to work in a fast-paced, growing tech environment and to foster change in larger organizations.

jobs.description:
Join us at Wolters Kluwer and be part of a dynamic global technology company that makes a difference every day. We’re innovators with impact. We provide expert software and information solutions that the world’s leading professionals rely on, in the moments that matter most.

We are currently looking for a Senior Product Software Engineer
to join our team.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will work as a full-time Full Stack Developer within a hybrid work model, contributing to the design, development, and evolution of scalable software solutions.

This role requires strong hands-on technical expertise, the ability to work independently with minimal guidance, and accountability for delivering high-quality solutions within a modern, cloud-based, microservices-oriented architecture.

At this level, engineers are expected to solve complex technical problems, apply best practices, and act as a technical reference for peers while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-End Software Development Design, develop, test, and maintain full stack applications using modern backend and frontend technologies, ensuring high quality, performance, and maintainability.
Backend Development & Architecture Build and evolve RESTful APIs and microservices based on .NET (.NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API, C#), applying OOP, SOLID principles, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Clean Code practices within decoupled architectures.
Frontend Development Develop and maintain rich web applications using Angular, ensuring usability, performance, and alignment with backend services.
Asynchronous Communication & Messaging Design and implement asynchronous workflows using RabbitMQ, MassTransit, and Azure Service Bus, ensuring reliability and scalability.
Data Management & Caching Work with SQL-based relational databases and Redis to ensure efficient data storage, access, and caching strategies.
Testing & Quality Assurance Implement and maintain unit and integration tests, contributing to robust testing frameworks and ensuring system reliability.
CI/CD & Automation Design, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, YAML pipelines, Git, supporting automated builds, testing, and deployments.
Cloud & Containerization Deploy and operate applications using Docker and Kubernetes, contributing to scalable and resilient cloud-native solutions.
Technical Problem Solving Analyze complex technical issues, evaluate multiple solutions, and apply sound judgment to resolve problems effectively.
Monitoring & Traceability Experience with application performance monitoring (APM), observability and tracing tools like Datadog or Grafana.
Collaboration & Communication Work closely with product, QA, and other engineering teams; explain complex technical topics clearly and contribute to alignment and consensus.
Knowledge Sharing & Team Impact Act as a technical resource for team members, sharing best practices and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Skills & Experience:

Core Technical Skills:

Strong experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer
Advanced knowledge of:
C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, ASP.NET Web API
Angular
RESTful APIs and microservices architectures
SQL and relational database design
Redis
Asynchronous messaging systems (RabbitMQ, MassTransit, Azure Service Bus)

Solid understanding of:
OOP, SOLID principles
Domain-Driven Design (DDD)
Clean Code practices

Engineering Practices:

Unit and integration testing frameworks
Git, GitHub, and collaborative source code management
CI/CD with Azure DevOps and YAML pipelines
Containerization with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
Hands-on experience with monitoring and traceability ecosystems (e.g., Datadog, Grafana).
Agile methodologies (Scrum / Kanban)

Competencies:

Analytical Thinking – Ability to break down complex problems and design effective solutions.
Functional & Operational Expertise – Deep technical knowledge applied pragmatically to real-world systems.
Accountability – Ownership of deliverables and ongoing technical responsibilities.
Inclusive Collaboration – Works effectively with diverse roles and teams.
Drive to Perform – Focus on quality, reliability, and continuous improvement.

If you think that you have the needed requirements click on the apply button to join us and be the difference
. If making a difference matters to you, then you matter to us.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or any other protected status, in accordance with local regulations.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Global OT Application Developer
jobs.description:
The Global OT Application Developer
builds, maintains, tests and stabilises application components and use cases for industrial environments. The role converts approved requirements, designs and standards into reliable software, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards that can be reused across applications and sites.

The Application Developer works closely with Application Engineers throughout implementation, integration, testing and stabilisation, must understand the operational and technical context in which the solution will run, and remains involved in resolving defects and technical issues. It is not an isolated coding position.

Assigned scope:

Configuration and development of use cases within Global OT applications.
Development and maintenance of standard interfaces between Global OT applications.
Implementation of improvements to ensure correct performance of Global OT applications and interfaces.
Writing and maintaining technical documentation, release notes and other documentation required for proper software governance.

Primary emphasis:

Features that are stable, maintainable and suitable for reuse across applications or sites.
Code and configurations for use cases and interfaces that follow agreed versioning and delivery practices.
Documented components that Application Engineers can integrate, deploy and support.

Main tasks / Standard of performance

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.
Build and maintain within application domains such as IIoT, MES, SCADA, historians and maintenance systems.
Develop database structures and application interfaces in accordance with the approved design and relevant application practices.
Maintain existing applications and application components and adapt them when approved requirements or standards change.

Test and stabilise:

Take responsibility for the technical quality of the developments and configurations.
Create and execute developer-level tests and support broader functional and integration testing.
Identify, diagnose and correct defects discovered during implementation, testing and stabilisation.
Verify that the code deliverables meet the defined requirements and behave reliably in the target application environment.
Support Application Engineers during integration and deployment when code, configuration or component-level troubleshooting is required.

Reuse, standards and maintainability:

Ensure that development can be governed, maintained and reused beyond a single isolated requirement.
Use reusable logics, UX/UI and features where appropriate.
Follow agreed coding, configuration, naming and documentation standards,
Consider performance, reliability and maintainability when implementing application requirements.
Document code, configurations, dependencies and technical behaviour clearly enough for integration and support.

Controlled delivery and versioning:

Develop within the agreed versioning, review and release process.
Use Git or the agreed source-control platform for versioning and collaboration.
Follow the applicable CI/CD, code-review, testing and release practices
Maintain traceability between approved requirements, implemented changes and delivered versions.
Contribute to the correction and stabilisation of released components when development changes are required.

Collaboration across the application lifecycle:

Work with the Application Owner on approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Work with Application Engineers on technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs.
Clarify functional and technical requirements with the relevant business, engineering and architecture contributors.
Provide transparent estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status to the relevant delivery lead or Scrum Master.
Participate in defect resolution and technical discussions with vendors or system integrators when the developed components are involved.

Application-specific requirements:

SQL and application database development.
Programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning and collaborative development practices.
Implementation, testing, defect correction and feature stabilisation.
CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Creation and maintenance of technical documentation covering code, configurations, interfaces and delivered components.
Contribution across IIoT applications and use cases (including platforms such as Ignition), MES applications, historian and industrial-data applications, and maintenance applications, depending on the assigned application background.

Skills And Competencies

Functional & Technical Competencies:

Advanced: SQL and application database development, including database structures and application interfaces.
Advanced: programming or scripting using Python, C#, Java or comparable technologies.
Proficient: industrial integration using MQTT, OPC UA and REST APIs.
Git-based versioning, CI/CD, code review and controlled release practices.
Working knowledge of secure software development lifecycle requirements under IEC 62443-4-1.
Working knowledge of application domains such as IIoT (including platforms such as Ignition), MES, historians and maintenance systems.

Behavioral Competencies:

Structured, pragmatic and quality-oriented, with strong ownership of the technical quality of own deliverables.
Constructive challenge of requirements, designs and technical solutions where quality or maintainability is at risk.
Clear cross-functional communication of estimates, risks, dependencies and delivery status across engineering, business and external audiences.

Experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's or master's degree in software, computer science, automation, electrical or industrial engineering, or comparable practical experience.
Experience developing and maintaining software components for industrial or manufacturing applications such as IIoT, MES, historians or maintenance systems; senior appointments normally require demonstrated ownership of complex application components across multiple applications or sites.
Professional English; additional languages relevant to the assigned region are an advantage.

Working Conditions and Location:

Primary European hiring locations Barcelona and southern or western Germany.
Home-based or hybrid working, including collaboration with nearshore and distributed delivery teams.
Occasional travel to manufacturing sites where development support is required.

Responsibility / Power of authority

The Global OT Application Developer is accountable for:

Choosing detailed implementation approaches within approved requirements, architecture and standards.
Identifying technical risks and proposing improvements to components and delivery practices.
Raising concerns about potential future issues — technical debt, scalability, maintainability or obsolescence — to the Application Owner and architecture contributors before they affect operations.
Rejecting code or components that do not meet agreed quality and versioning practices.
Supporting integration, deployment and troubleshooting when development expertise is required.
The role does not own the application roadmap, backlog priorities or acceptance decisions, plant connectivity, site readiness, commissioning or operational support, and does not define platform architecture or approve material deviations from global standards; nor does it operate as an isolated programmer without testing, stabilisation and engineering collaboration.

Team work / Team membership

Communicates to:

Application Owner: approved scope, priorities, standards and acceptance expectations.
Application Engineers: technical integration, testing, deployment and support needs; day-to-day collaboration throughout implementation and stabilisation.
Delivery lead / Scrum Master: estimates, technical risks, dependencies and delivery status.
Business, engineering and architecture contributors: clarification of functional and technical requirements.
Vendors and system integrators: defect resolution and technical discussions where the developed components are involved.
Nearshore / distributed delivery teams: shared requirements, standards, testing, versioning and documentation practices; dotted-line collaboration with Application Engineers regardless of location.

Especificar APIs que den respuesta a dichos requisitos (OpenAPI 3.x, Swagger 2.0)
Crear y revisar Pull Requests en Azure DevOps
Garantizar que las APIs especificadas cumplen con su implementación real
Dar soporte a partners técnicos y de negocio en la integración de APIs
Participar en el comité de API Design Authority y en las comunidades internas de APIs
Evangelizar buenas prácticas de diseño de APIs dentro de la organización
Contribuir a la mejora de herramientas y procesos del equipo
Realizar y compartir vigilancia tecnológica sobre tendencias en el ámbito de las APIs

Al menos 5 años de experiencia como Business Analyst

Dominio de formatos JSON, XML y YAML
Experiencia con especificaciones OpenAPI 3.x y Swagger 2.0

Modelado con MindMap (XMind) y UML (diagramas de secuencia)

Soltura en la gestión y monitorización de entornos productivos
Experiencia trabajando con metodologías Agile

Experiencia en cloud: AWS, Azure, OpenShift
Conocimientos de C#, JavaScript o TypeScript
Lenguaje de consulta Kusto (KQL)
Seguridad: threat modeling y estándares actuales (SAML, OAuth2, JWT)
Especificaciones AsyncAPI y WSDL
Conocimiento del estándar ACORD
Herramientas como Azure DevOps y Application Insights

Idiomas

Nivel de inglés fluido, imprescindible

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.location: Greater Palma de Mallorca Metropolitan Area
jobs.description:
Siemens, a global leader with over 175 years of history, made a revolutionary move 7 years ago with the creation of Siemens Advanta, its specialized division in consulting and digital transformation. As a trusted advisor, Siemens Advanta forms lasting partnerships with clients, guiding them on their journey towards the digitalization and modernization of their organizations.

We are the catalyst for the digital transformation of the industrial world, unlocking the digital future of our clients by offering end-to-end support in their unique digitalization journey.

The Iberia region has consolidated itself as one of the most dynamic and promising markets for Siemens Advanta, with significant investment in resources and capabilities.

We currently have a team of over 100 highly qualified professionals offering professional services structured into three fundamental areas:

Consulting: Helping clients understand their digital maturity, create an evolution plan based on their priorities, improve production excellence, process improvement, define business digitalization, and reduce costs.
Digital Solution Design: Understanding client needs and transforming them into technological solutions (both IT and OT).
Digital Solution Implementation: Implementing software development applications, data platforms, Cloud & On-Prem infrastructures, reporting systems, LowCode applications, etc.

Your Role

We are looking for a Solution Architect – Software to join our growing team in Iberia. As a Solution Architect, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, shaping, and governing the architecture of transformative software solutions. You will bridge business requirements with technical execution, lead multidisciplinary engineering teams, shape strategic customer opportunities, drive pre-sales initiatives, and mentor technical talent to build organizational capability.

Your mission will be to define end-to-end solution architectures that are technically sound, scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives and Siemens governance requirements. You will act as a strategic technical authority across solution design, architecture definition, and customer-critical engagements.

Your Responsibilities

Define and govern end-to-end solution architectures across software, cloud, data, and AI-enabled initiatives, ensuring strategic alignment with organizational capabilities
Translate business requirements and strategic objectives into technically feasible solution designs, architecture blueprints, and implementation approaches
Lead architecture definition across application layers, data flows, integration patterns, security requirements, and operational considerations
Provide senior technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams, guiding complex technical decisions and delivery challenges
Shape strategic customer solutions by defining technical approaches that drive business value and competitive advantage
Support pre-sales and proposal activities contributing to technical estimates, feasibility analysis, and executive-ready documentation
Communicate and defend architectural designs to executive stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into business implications
Mentor and coach technical team members supporting capability development, architectural maturity, and professional growth
Manage project budgets and timelines ensuring financial and schedule viability
Ensure solutions meet agreed standards for scalability, performance, resilience, cybersecurity, data privacy, and operational readiness

What You Offer

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or comparable technical discipline

Experience:

8-10+ years of relevant professional experience as a Software Architect, Senior Software Engineer, or in similar senior technical leadership roles
Proven experience designing, delivering, and leading complex technology solutions in multidisciplinary environments with strategic customer engagement
Demonstrated technical leadership guiding multiple development teams and making architectural decisions
Experience with Generative AI, AI-enabled solutions, AI-assisted software engineering, and intelligent automation
Proven ability to lead technical discussions with senior stakeholders and shape strategic customer solutions
Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, proposals, and solution concepts with demonstrated business impact

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge in end-to-end solution architecture and strategic design
Advanced proficiency in cloud architecture (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud), microservices, and cloud-native architectures
Strong expertise in data architecture, API design, integration patterns, DevOps, and security principles
Generative AI, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent automation architectures
Technology selection and architecture trade-off analysis

Technical Knowledge (High Level Required):

Project Management & Technical Leadership
Microsoft Azure
SQL
Excel and PowerPoint
AI/ML Concepts and Generative AI
Professional Certifications (cloud, architecture, or AI-related) – Required

Competencies:

Strategic and systems thinking with business acumen
Technical leadership and ability to influence senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams
Clear communication of complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
Ownership and accountability for solution integrity and business outcomes
Coaching, mentoring, and organizational capability building
Learning agility and adaptability to emerging technologies
Executive presence and strategic customer engagement
Professional reliability, integrity, and sound judgment

Language:

Advanced level of English (oral and written)
Spanish or other European languages are an advantage

What We Offer

At Siemens Advanta, we believe that great results start with great people. That's why we offer attractive working conditions in an environment where you are truly valued — with flexible working hours, a flexible remuneration plan, and a wide range of benefits and measures designed with our team in mind. Beyond the perks, what makes this opportunity truly unique is the chance to be a founding pillar of something bold and ambitious in Iberia, contributing to one of the most exciting energy revolutions of our generation at the very moment where strategy meets action. We also invest in your growth through training and technical certifications, because we know that your development and our success go hand in hand.

If you are passionate about technology, innovation, and making a positive impact on the global energy transition, this is your place. Apply now and be part of the team that is building the digital future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
jobs.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title:
Principal Solution Architect (PI Data Infrastructure / CONNECT Digital Twin)

Location:
Cambridge, UK or Madrid, Spain

Employment Type:
Full-time, hybrid role

The job

We are looking for a Principal Solution Architect to lead architecture, solution design, and customer engagement for PI Data Infrastructure and AVEVA CONNECT Digital Twin initiatives. This role will work with global and regional teams to deliver scalable, value-driven industrial data solutions across sectors such as energy, mining, utilities, manufacturing, chemicals, and data centres. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers and internal teams, helping translate business needs into robust technical architectures and successful delivery outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead solution architecture, workshops, implementation planning, and technical design for PI Data Infrastructure and CONNECT Digital Twin customer programmes
Engage with customers to gather requirements, manage stakeholders, and act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for PI DI initiatives
Define architecture standards, templates, best practices, and rollout approaches for multi-site or enterprise deployments
Collaborate with product management, services, sales, pre-sales, and delivery teams to shape customer value, identify new use cases, and provide product feedback
Mentor and guide multi-disciplinary teams, including solution architects, senior engineers, developers, UX specialists, and industry experts

Essential Requirements

15+ years of relevant experience in solution architecture, consulting, services delivery, or industrial software implementation
Deep experience with PI Data Infrastructure, including PI Server installation, configuration, connectivity, protocols, alerting, aggregation, Asset Framework, PI Vision, and PI DataLink
Strong industrial domain experience in sectors such as energy, mining, data centres, utilities, chemicals, manufacturing, or other asset-intensive environments
Proven ability to lead customer workshops, translate requirements into clear system designs, and communicate effectively with IT, OT, plant leadership, and business stakeholders
Experience leading or supporting global or regional industrial data programmes across multiple plants or sites

Desired Skills And Competencies

Experience with AVEVA CONNECT capabilities, including CONNECT Data, sharing, analytics, visualisation, digital twin, DataOps, and AI/ML-enabled use cases
Strong understanding of SCADA systems, PI Interfaces and Connectors, OPC DA/UA, Modbus, DCS systems, and industrial automation data connectivity
Experience with AF SDK/.NET, PI system administration, archive management, PI calculations, troubleshooting, backups, and operational dashboard design
Ability to map customer KPIs and use cases, such as operational efficiency, compliance, sustainability, asset monitoring, CBM, and data consolidation, to PI DI and CONNECT value outcomes
Experience supporting pre-sales, solution estimation, proposal development, project risk management, and partner or capability-building initiatives

Services at AVEVA

Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

AVEVA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business. AVEVA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities where appropriate. If you need reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process, please notify your recruiter. Determinations on requests for reasonable accommodation will be made on a case-by-case basis.

jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for an Engineering Manager, Client (Unity) to join our new unannounced project in Barcelona, Spain to work on a hybrid basis 3 times a week. We can support with visa sponsorship and relocation support

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a distributed team of game enthusiasts who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world every day

We embrace AI-forward development practices and expect our engineers to be curious and pragmatic about how these tools can raise the bar

We are in the development stages of a bold, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title. We are looking for passionate game makers to collaborate, get in early and make their mark on this exciting venture

What You Will Do

Lead and manage a team of experienced engineers who focus on developing and maintaining the game client
Design and implement new features in our game client, working collaboratively with other stakeholder teams to understand requirements and identify the best technical solutions
Propose and implement improvements to our development processes, workflows and tools, to increase efficiency, quality and throughput
Conduct pair programming, code reviews, 1-1’s and knowledge sharing sessions to enhance skills and build a strong development culture
Work closely with QA to resolve bugs and deliver high-quality code for testing, contributing directly to the code base
Be the quality gate for all code that goes into our game. Keep the team writing clean, efficient and optimized code
Work with stakeholders to figure out and implement the best alternative technical solutions
Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows in your daily work — from tech planning, code generation and review to exploring novel solutions

What We’re Looking For

Have technically led or managed a team (any size really)
Proven ability to engage and motivate, to bring out the best in people
Experienced being part of a professional development team working on game client features or other relevant areas
Familiarity with software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
Excellent experience working with multiple stakeholders in the development process - be able to understand their goals, and deliver/ evaluate various tech solutions to meet these
Strong technical skills and experience in at least one of the following areas: game engines, rendering engines, networking, physics, AI, audio
Excellent programming skills in C# or C++
Experience in mobile and/or PC game development
Experience with version control, build tools and deployment pipelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Knowledge of software engineering best practices and trends
Hands-on experience working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code) and an understanding of how agentic workflows can augment engineering productivity.

Bonus points

Experience with automated testing and continuous integration
Experience with cloud technologies and services for game development
Knowledge of game design principles and user experience

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications.
