jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
NTT DATA
es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría.

Digital Technology
es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica.

Digital Architecture
es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades.

Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de arquitectura en Azure
y buscamos perfiles capaces de diseñar soluciones que combinen innovación, gobierno y fiabilidad operativa. Personas con criterio para conectar necesidades de negocio, requisitos regulatorios y decisiones tecnológicas, construyendo arquitecturas preparadas para evolucionar. Como Microsoft Gold Partner
, en NTT DATA impulsamos soluciones sobre Azure que combinan innovación tecnológica, gobierno y cumplimiento normativo. Trabajamos en proyectos donde la nube debe integrarse de forma realista con entornos existentes, modernizar aplicaciones críticas y habilitar plataformas empresariales escalables, seguras y conectadas con el ecosistema Microsoft.

¿Qué nos gustaría que aportaras?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que contaras con:
Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando y evolucionando arquitecturas cloud sobre Microsoft Azure
, en entornos empresariales complejos.
Conocimiento sólido de los servicios esenciales de Azure para el diseño de soluciones: identidad, redes, cómputo, almacenamiento, bases de datos, integración, observabilidad, seguridad y gobierno.
Experiencia aplicando principios del Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework
y definiendo arquitecturas escalables, resilientes, seguras y eficientes.
Capacidad para diseñar y evolucionar entornos híbridos, conectando Azure con infraestructuras on-premise , otras nubes y el ecosistema Microsoft.
Experiencia en la definición de landing zones , modelos de gobierno, estructuras de suscripciones, políticas, gestión de identidades y controles de cumplimiento.
Conocimiento de estrategias de modernización y migración de aplicaciones, valorando alternativas basadas en servicios PaaS, contenedores, arquitecturas serverless o plataformas gestionadas.
Criterio para abordar decisiones de seguridad y cumplimiento: Microsoft Entra ID, gestión de secretos, segmentación de red, cifrado, monitorización, auditoría y protección de cargas.
Capacidad para colaborar con equipos de ingeniería, plataformas, ciberseguridad, datos y responsables de negocio, facilitando decisiones técnicas alineadas con los objetivos del proyecto.

También valoraremos positivamente:
Certificaciones de Microsoft Azure, especialmente Azure Solutions Architect Expert
, o experiencia práctica alineada con sus dominios de conocimiento.
Experiencia con infraestructura como código y automatización mediante Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates o Azure DevOps.
Conocimiento de Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Arc, plataformas de integración, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos o prácticas DevSecOps.
Participación en iniciativas de gobierno cloud, optimización de costes, Cloud Center of Excellence o evolución de modelos operativos.
Interés por las capacidades de datos e inteligencia artificial del ecosistema Azure y por su integración en arquitecturas empresariales.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
Diseñar arquitecturas objetivo en Azure que respondan a necesidades de negocio y equilibren seguridad, escalabilidad, disponibilidad, rendimiento, gobierno y coste.
Definir patrones, estándares y arquitecturas de referencia reutilizables para acelerar el diseño y la adopción de soluciones cloud.
Diseñar y evolucionar landing zones , modelos de gobierno y controles técnicos que permitan utilizar Azure de forma segura, ordenada y escalable.
Acompañar proyectos de modernización, migración e integración híbrida, ayudando a seleccionar el enfoque tecnológico más adecuado para cada caso.
Evaluar decisiones de arquitectura, identificar riesgos y proponer alternativas ante retos de conectividad, identidad, integración, cumplimiento o operación.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, plataformas y ciberseguridad para asegurar que los diseños se llevan a la práctica de forma consistente y sostenible.
Facilitar conversaciones entre equipos técnicos y responsables de negocio, transformando necesidades complejas en decisiones de arquitectura y roadmaps accionables.
Contribuir al desarrollo de la práctica de Azure mediante la compartición de conocimiento, la creación de activos reutilizables y la exploración de capacidades relevantes del ecosistema Microsoft.

📍 Aunque nuestra búsqueda está centrada principalmente en Madrid, también tenemos equipos en Barcelona, Coruña, Bilbao, Oviedo, Sevilla, Valencia, Valladolid y Zaragoza. Por lo que si vives en estas u otras ciudades también nos interesa tu perfil y estaremos encantados de conocerte.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
🧠 Formar parte de un equipo de élite especializado en la unión entre estrategia y tecnología.
💼 Contrato indefinido con revisiones de categoría y salario de manera anual.
🎓 Certificaciones bonificadas de los principales proveedores cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) y otras tecnologías.
📝 Acceso gratuito a nuestra plataforma formativa, NTT DATA University , donde encontrarás formaciones técnicas, metodológicas, idiomas y soft skills.
💻 Trabajo híbrido y horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación.
📅 Jornada intensiva (8:00 a 15:00) los viernes y los meses de verano.
🏥 Beneficios corporativos: complementos salariales adicionales, retribución flexible, seguro médico, seguro de vida y accidentes y muchos más.
🌊 Programas solidarios y actividades sociales para impulsar un impacto positivo a través de nuestro portal de voluntarios The Blue Wave .
🔝 Un ambiente de trabajo excelente, que fomenta el compañerismo y la buena convivencia. Somos Global Top Employer 2025, y, en España, por 10º año consecutivo.
🌏 Innovación diversa y cultura inclusiva. En NTT DATA creemos que cada persona es única y apostamos por una cultura que valora la diversidad y fomenta un entorno donde todos podamos explorar y potenciar nuestra singularidad.

¡Únete al equipo de Digital Technology en NTT DATA!

jobs.title: Associate Developer - (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
NEXT | eDO Tech Graduate Program

You’re a tech or IT student. You’re about to graduate or you have done so for a year or so. You start to wonder about the future. And then you ask yourself what’s next.

eDO is NEXT!

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe.

If you’re looking for the best opportunity to start your career in the tech field, then think no more. eDO’s Graduate Program is here to help you ease all of those questions that arise when you are starting to build your career. At eDO you’ll not only learn and develop but also help to shape the future of travel at the world’s leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe using cutting-edge technology.

So, what’s NEXT?

NEXT is a one-year graduate program
developed by eDreams ODIGEO and designed for those who are about to or have recently graduated from a tech-related degree.

It’s focused on personal learning and development and at the same time allowing you to have a real experience of what it is like to work at eDO.

No serving coffees or doing copies, here you’ll have the chance to do real work that has an impact on the company. Ok, maybe a cup of coffee or two because they are free at the office and we can always have a quick break.

What you will do:

The main goal here is to learn. So don’t worry if you still don’t have a lot of experience or knowledge. We got your back.

During NEXT you’ll be able to develop the technical and soft skills that will help you start your career in technology to later keep growing through our career path. NEXT up, these are some of the things to expect:

Work directly in one of our Agile multidisciplinary teams where you will influence products in one of our many areas, such as our booking experience, payments, searches and many more, working with cutting-edge technologies, like Java 8 to Java 11, ES6 code, frameworks like Backbone, Javascript libraries like ReactJS, VueJS and Lodash, Big Data (Kafka, Cassandra, Redis, Neo4j…), BigTable, Docker, Google Cloud, Style Sheet preprocessors like SASS, testing frameworks and libraries like Mocha, Chai, Underscore, Automatic Functional Testing (Selenium + Cucumber + NodeJS) or packages and task runners like WebPack, Babel, Grunt, NPM.
Develop hands-on experience with applied AI development tools, including AI-powered coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot to improve development efficiency, code quality, and team productivity.
A dedicated onboarding and career path, tailored to your needs and goals, with the possibility of choosing a Backend or Frontend path.
Mentoring from experienced peers, with guided training and learning on the job with Senior Developers, Architects, QA Managers and many more.
A true open culture where feedback is king. We work in an open and collaborative environment where every door is open and any idea is valued.

What can I do NEXT?

Apply!

If you’re a recent graduate
from any tech-related field
, such as Computer Science or similar, are f luent in English
and still don’t have a lot of work experience, then what are you waiting for?

Of course, it helps if you have coded before, but more than experience, we’re looking for people with a fresh and proactive attitude
with a sharp analytical mindset
. You’re basically a go-getter
who is always looking for ways to improve and iterate.

A strong interest and demonstrated engagement in AI is a must.

This includes exposure to or hands-on experience with Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or automation, whether through academic coursework, personal projects, online learning, or independent experimentation. Curiosity alone is not enough; you should already be actively exploring or applying AI in some form.

But most importantly, you’re eager to learn!

What can I get NEXT?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At NEXT you’ll have the same benefits as an eDOer. It’s not like we love lists, but here are just some of the main ones:

A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it after 3 years.

Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.

Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.

Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.

Work hard, party hard ! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.

Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.

So, think no more and take the NEXT step! Apply now!

eDreams ODIGEO is the world’s leading travel subscription platform and one of the largest e-commerce businesses in Europe. Under its four renowned online travel agency brands – eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo – it serves more than 21 million customers per year across 44 markets. Listed on the Spanish Stock Market, eDreams ODIGEO works with nearly 700 airlines. The business launched Prime, the first subscription product in the travel sector which has topped over 6 million members since launching in 2017. The brand offers the best quality products in regular flights, low-cost airlines, hotels, dynamic packages, car rental and travel insurance to make travel easier, more accessible, and better value for consumers across the globe.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

jobs.title: Backend Developer - Turkish Speaking
jobs.description:
About Codeway

Codeway builds category-leading consumer AI apps on mobile and web, at global scale.

600M+ downloads. 60+ apps. 400+ builders across Barcelona and İstanbul. Completely bootstrapped. No board. Profitable since year two.

Small teams move faster than big ones. But they need big resources to win at scale. Nobody starts from zero. The problem decides the solution, not us.

We turn category wins into six focused vertical companies: Wishlabs (AI Creativity), Wellture (Wellness), Learna (Education), Sparked (Media), Cosmic Jam (Entertainment), and Catalyst Apps (Utilities & Productivity). Each has full ownership and the depth to go further than anyone else in its space.

Codeway HQ powers them all. One platform. One team that finds and grows builders. One set of guardrails. Every idea born here starts with an unfair advantage: the platform, the people, and the profits of every product before it. That's the system.

Turns out you can do both.

Move like an indie. Hit like a giant.

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer, Backend at Codeway, you will design, build, and operate the scalable backend services that power mobile apps and web experiences used by millions. You won't just write code; you will own features end-to-end - from initial system design and AI integration to deployment and production monitoring - with a strong focus on API quality, performance, and reliability.

Our environment is fast-paced, and we value engineers who can turn complex architectural challenges into simple, elegant, and maintainable solutions. The ideal candidate will be comfortable building backend services for mobile products and working with API-heavy consumer apps.

You will collaborate with mobile, product, AI, and DevOps teams to ship features end to end, bringing AI-powered capabilities into production where relevant.

What You’ll Be Doing

Design and implement scalable systems. Build high-performance backend architectures and microservices/RESTful APIs for mobile and web clients using Node.js and Python.
Own features end-to-end. Take full responsibility for the lifecycle of your services, from ideation and implementation through to deployment (GCP/Firebase) and continuous optimisation.
Integrate AI and media workflows. Deploy, monitor, and support LLMs and media workflows (STT/TTS, image/video/audio processing) in production, managing model serving, inference performance, and latency/cost tradeoffs.
Architect asynchronous workflows. Implement robust event-driven systems using queues and tasks to handle heavy media and AI workloads.
Simplify systems. Evaluate every component and process to remove unnecessary complexity and build minimalist, future-proof architectures.
Optimise performance. Proactively identify bottlenecks across distributed systems to improve latency, throughput, reliability, and costs.
Ensure backend quality. Establish robust error handling, security best practices, and end-to-end observability, and contribute to code quality through reviews, testing, and documentation.
Troubleshoot and stabilise. Debug issues and proactively improve system stability and observability in production environments.
Collaborate cross-functionally. Partner with Mobile, Frontend, Product, DevOps, and AI teams to design and ship impactful features.

What You’ll Bring

Experience. 3+ years of professional experience as a Backend Engineer, with a track record of building consumer-facing products at scale.
Technical excellence. Strong hands-on proficiency in both Node.js and Python, with a deep understanding of CS fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and system design.
System design. Experience designing and working with microservices architectures and RESTful APIs, with a solid grasp of databases, data modelling, performance optimisation, and security best practices.
Infrastructure knowledge. Hands-on experience with cloud environments such as GCP, AWS, or Azure (GCP and/or Firebase preferred), with strong production debugging and observability habits.
AI familiarity. Experience deploying and optimising AI models in production, including familiarity with external AI APIs and their performance considerations.
Scale. Ability to contribute effectively in high-scale environments handling large volumes of traffic and data, with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Communication. Proficiency in English and Turkish, with the ability to explain complex engineering decisions and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical teams.
Education. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to have

Experience supporting mobile apps through backend APIs.
Experience with GCP tools such as Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Cloud Functions, or App Engine.
Familiarity with containerisation and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices.
Familiarity with SSE or WebSockets for real-time communication.
Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or SQS.

What We Offer

The chance to work with a high-caliber, passionate international team building category-defining products
Full-time contract with competitive salary
Private health insurance, a generous meal card
Full visa & relocation support if you’re moving to Barcelona
Annual learning & development budget for courses, tools, or events that support your growth
Wellness perks, including sports budget and psychological consultations.
Free access to Codeway’s suite of apps across productivity, wellness, and education
A top-notch office in the heart of the city

jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Colliers is a leading diversified professional services and investment management company. With operations in 68 countries, our 22,000 enterprising people work collaboratively to provide expert advice to maximize the potential of property and real assets to accelerate the success of our clients, our investors and our people.

We are at the forefront of the real estate industry, leading the way and backed by an exceptional record of success. We are building for our future – and yours.

We strive to build our business at a competitive pace by augmenting internal growth with smart strategic acquisitions that increase market share, expand service offerings and extend our geographic reach for the benefit of our clients and shareholders.

For more than 29 years, Colliers has created value for shareholders that has resulted in superior returns and industry growth. Our people also own significant equity in our business, which brings pride of ownership to everything we do. We are passionate, take personal responsibility and always do what's right for our clients, people and communities.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Senior QA Engineer
for our newly established Technology Hub
in Madrid. This is a unique opportunity to become part of the founding team that helps shape the culture, practices, and technical direction. Working in a hybrid model
(remote & onsite), you will enjoy significant freedom to innovate and influence
the future of one of the world’s largest commercial real estate companies. With the leadership of the Global Technology Hub coming from a background of technology startups, you will benefit from a fast-paced learning environment, high visibility of your contributions and opportunities to shape processes, culture and technology strategies. At the same time, you take advantage of the stability, resources, and reach of a successful global company
.

Guided by our global digital strategy, the Madrid Hub collaborates closely with international teams to deliver world-class technology solutions
that power the future of commercial real estate.

As Senior QA Engineer
, you will be instrumental in ensuring the delivery of high-quality, reliable and scalable enterprise software solutions. You will contribute to global products and platforms that serve both internal and external customers in Commercial Real Estate across multiple regions. Working closely with international Product, Engineering, DevOps, Data, QA and Architecture teams, you will ensure delivery excellence, software quality and great customer experience.

Your expertise will contribute directly to the quality of modern, component-based frontend application built with React and Typescript, as well as robust backend services developed in .NET.

You are a hands-on problem-solver with strong quality principles, who thrives in a collaborative and agile environment. This role offers the opportunity to influence technical direction and mentor junior members of the team while building solutions with real business impact.

Automation-First Test-Strategy

Collaborate towards the creation of a reusable automation testing framework
Develop and maintain comprehensive automated tests suites across frontend, backend, and API layers using tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Postman.
Lead the implementation of testing frameworks that support both functional and non-functional testing, with a focus on early detection of defects and fast feedback loops.
Partner with engineers to incorporate testing considerations into development efforts from the earliest stages – ensuring code is testable, scalable and maintainable.
Embed automated tests directly into CI/CD pipelines, working with DevOps and Engineering Operations to build quality gates and establish fast, reliable release workflows.
Drive culture of test-first development with unit-, integration- and performance-testing
Support root cause analysis and resolution of production issues, ensuring high reliability and uptime
Help define and adhere to coding standards, documentation and software lifecycle best practices.

Tooling and Process Development

Guide the selection and implementation of modern QA tools across test management, performance testing and frontend testing (Storybook integration).
Contribute to the standardization of test environments and data management strategies
Set up processes and practices to reduce test flakiness, support parallel execution, and minimize test execution times.
Advocate for meaningful test coverage that aligns with product requirements and end-user behavior, using Figma and user stories to guide test case development.

Technical Leadership

Act as a technical mentor to mid-level and junior engineers within your team or project and beyond.
Identify opportunities for technical improvements and advocate for high-quality engineering standards
Participate in design and code review sessions to uphold engineering excellence across the team
Take on technical ownership of production systems
Continuous improvement of agile methodologies and tools

Global Collaboration

Work closely with Product Owners and Product team to refine acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and ensure business needs are clearly understood and validated.
Work closely with DevOps and Engineering Operations teams to optimize build pipelines, observability and deployment automation.
Share insights and best practices across teams, helping to foster a strong quality mindset throughout the engineering department.
Ensure compliance with global standards, information security policies and regulatory requirements

Qualifications

Required Skills/Experience:

8+ years of experience in a QA or software testing role, with a strong background in test automation and modern development workflows.
Experience testing modern web applications using React, Typescript and .NET technologies.
Hand-on experience with frontend and end-to-end testing frameworks.
Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman or Cypress, with experience writing automated API tests and validating backend behavior
Experience with integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or similar platforms.
Agile Development experience (Scrum/Kanban), including story estimation, code reviews and pair programming.
Experience working in distributed or remote teams and using tools such as Jira, GitHub, Miro and Azure DevOps.
Familiarity with test case management tools and practices
Solid understanding of performance optimization.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, fluent in English and Spanish.
Passionate about building high-quality software products with empowered teams.
Understanding of secure development practices and compliance frameworks (e.g. ISO27001, GDPR, SOC2).

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience with performance testing and security testing tools
Experience in working in a global, multi-cultural organization.
Exposure to domain-driven design (DDD) and event-driven architecture.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, growing tech environment and to foster change in larger organizations

jobs.description:
¿Te imaginas participando en la transformación de las principales organizaciones nacionales e internacionales?

En Deloitte estamos comprometidos con generar un impacto en la sociedad, en nuestros clientes y en ti.

Sobre la posición

Buscamos incorporar un/a Gerente o Senior Manager de Consultoría Tecnológica para reforzar nuestro equipo de Ingeniería y Arquitectura de Datos .

La persona seleccionada tendrá un papel relevante en el crecimiento de la práctica, combinando desarrollo de negocio, liderazgo de clientes, definición de soluciones y dirección integral de proyectos de Data & Analytics . Buscamos un perfil con autonomía comercial, capacidad para gestionar iniciativas complejas y experiencia liderando equipos de consultoría en entornos tecnológicos exigentes.

Será responsable de impulsar oportunidades alrededor del dato, desarrollar relaciones de confianza con clientes y partners tecnológicos y asegurar la correcta ejecución técnica, económica y operativa de los proyectos bajo su responsabilidad.

¿Cuál será tu misión?

Contribuir al desarrollo de nuestra oferta de Data Engineering, Data Architecture y Cloud Analytics , liderando tanto la actividad comercial como la ejecución de proyectos y la evolución del equipo.

La posición combina cuatro dimensiones principales:

Desarrollo de negocio y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Dirección técnica y económica de proyectos.
Soporte a la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos.
Liderazgo, desarrollo y crecimiento de equipos.

¿Qué responsabilidades asumirás?

Desarrollo de negocio y liderazgo comercial

Identificar, desarrollar y liderar oportunidades comerciales relacionadas con Data Engineering, Cloud Analytics, Data Platforms y Data Strategy .
Gestionar la relación con clientes, generando nuevas oportunidades y contribuyendo a la apertura y desarrollo de cuentas.
Liderar procesos de preventa y respuestas a RFP complejas y de gran envergadura .
Coordinar la elaboración de propuestas, estimaciones económicas, modelos de prestación y planes de trabajo.
Realizar defensas comerciales y técnicas ante interlocutores de negocio y tecnología.
Definir propuestas de valor y soluciones alrededor de:
Data Strategy y Data Assessments.
Modern Data Platforms y Data Lakes.
Arquitecturas de datos cloud, híbridas y on-premise.
Business Intelligence y Analytics.
DataOps y MLOps.
Plataformas de streaming y procesamiento en tiempo real.

Desarrollar relaciones con alianzas y partners tecnológicos, identificando oportunidades conjuntas de mercado.

Dirección de proyectos y gestión económica

Dirigir de forma concurrente una cartera aproximada de tres o cuatro proyectos .
Asegurar el cumplimiento de los compromisos de alcance, calidad, plazo y presupuesto.
Gestionar riesgos, dependencias, planificación, capacidad y carga de los equipos.
Realizar el seguimiento financiero de los proyectos, incluyendo ingresos, costes, margen, previsiones y desviaciones.
Mantener una interlocución ejecutiva con los clientes durante todo el ciclo de vida de los proyectos.
Participar en la resolución de situaciones críticas, facilitando la toma de decisiones y la definición de planes de acción.
Asegurar la calidad de los entregables y la coherencia de las soluciones con los objetivos del cliente.

Liderazgo técnico y de solución

Liderar la definición de arquitecturas y soluciones de datos desde una perspectiva de management, viabilidad, valor y posicionamiento comercial .
Orientar a los equipos en la selección de tecnologías, patrones arquitectónicos y modelos de implantación.
Conectar las necesidades de negocio con soluciones de ingeniería y arquitectura de datos escalables, seguras y sostenibles.
Participar en revisiones de arquitectura, estimaciones, planes de transición y hojas de ruta tecnológicas.
Identificar riesgos técnicos y operativos durante las fases de preventa y ejecución.

Gestión y desarrollo de equipos

Liderar equipos de entre 10 y 20 profesionales , con capacidad para asumir estructuras superiores a 20-25 personas a medida que crezca la práctica.
Coordinar managers, arquitectos, especialistas, consultores y perfiles de ingeniería.
Crear equipo y desarrollar capacidades, favoreciendo la incorporación, formación y evolución de nuevos profesionales.
Realizar seguimiento del desempeño, desarrollo profesional, asignación y cargabilidad de los equipos.
Promover la colaboración, la autonomía y la transmisión de conocimiento.
Actuar como referente para el equipo, generando metodología, buenas prácticas y una cultura de excelencia técnica y orientación al cliente.

¿Qué perfil buscamos?

Experiencia profesional

Experiencia previa de más de 2 años desempeñando funciones de Gerente en proyectos de Data, Analytics, Cloud o transformación tecnológica.
Experiencia contrastada en la dirección técnica y económica de proyectos de consultoría.
Experiencia gestionando simultáneamente varios proyectos, con responsabilidad sobre plazos, riesgos, presupuesto, margen y equipos.
Experiencia en el desarrollo y gestión de grandes cuentas.
Experiencia liderando preventas, propuestas y respuestas a RFP.
Capacidad para definir y defender arquitecturas y soluciones de datos ante interlocutores técnicos y ejecutivos.
Experiencia en gestión de equipos de más de 10 personas.
Se valorará experiencia gestionando una unidad, cartera de proyectos o cuenta con responsabilidad sobre su rendimiento económico.

Formación

Titulación universitaria en:
Ingeniería Informática.
Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones.
Ingeniería Industrial.
Matemáticas.
Física.
Otras titulaciones técnicas equivalentes.

Idiomas

Inglés fluido (b2/c1, preferiblemente c1). Debes ser capaz de liderar reuniones, defender una arquitectura y redactar documentación técnica compleja en inglés.
Capacidad para participar en propuestas, reuniones y presentaciones en entornos internacionales.

Conocimientos tecnológicos

Buscamos un perfil con visión amplia de las arquitecturas de datos y capacidad para tomar decisiones y liderar soluciones. No es imprescindible ser especialista técnico hands-on en todas las tecnologías, pero sí disponer de conocimiento suficiente para orientar propuestas, validar arquitecturas y mantener conversaciones de alto nivel con clientes y equipos técnicos.

Se valorará el grado de experiencia en los siguientes ámbitos:

Arquitecturas y plataformas de datos

Arquitecturas de Analytics en entornos cloud, híbridos y on-premise.
Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, Lakehouse y Modern Data Platforms.
Procesamiento batch, streaming y arquitecturas orientadas a eventos.
Integración, gobierno, seguridad y calidad del dato.
DataOps, DevOps y MLOps aplicados a plataformas de datos.

Cloud y plataformas analíticas

Microsoft Azure : Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, Analysis Services, Databricks, Delta Lake y Power BI.
Google Cloud Platform : Cloud Storage, Dataproc, Dataflow, BigQuery y herramientas de visualización del ecosistema Google Cloud.
Amazon Web Services : AWS Lambda, Glue, S3, Redshift, Athena, Redshift Spectrum y Kinesis.
Snowflake .
Databricks .

Ingeniería e integración de datos

Apache Kafka, Kafka Connect y tecnologías de procesamiento de eventos.
Ecosistemas Hadoop y plataformas como Cloudera.
Bases de datos SQL, incluyendo Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server y MySQL.
Herramientas y patrones de integración, transformación y explotación de datos.

Certificaciones valorables

Se valorarán certificaciones profesionales relacionadas con:

Microsoft Azure.
Google Cloud Platform.
Amazon Web Services.
Snowflake.
Databricks.
Gestión de servicios y proyectos, como ITIL o PMP .

Las certificaciones serán consideradas un elemento positivo, aunque se priorizará la experiencia real en gestión de clientes, desarrollo comercial, liderazgo de equipos y dirección de proyectos.

Competencias clave

Orientación al cliente

Capacidad para comprender las prioridades del cliente, construir relaciones de confianza y convertir necesidades de negocio en iniciativas y soluciones concretas.

Comunicación e influencia

Comunicación ejecutiva, clara y convincente. Capacidad para presentar y defender propuestas ante responsables de negocio, CIO, CDO, responsables de arquitectura y equipos técnicos.

Autonomía comercial

Capacidad para desarrollar relaciones con clientes, abrir oportunidades, movilizar equipos internos y liderar defensas comerciales con poca dependencia de terceros.

Capacidad comercial

Experiencia liderando RFP complejas, articulando propuestas de valor, definiendo soluciones y coordinando los componentes técnicos, económicos y operativos de una oferta.

Liderazgo

Capacidad para dirigir equipos multidisciplinares, delegar responsabilidades, desarrollar talento y acompañar el crecimiento de la práctica.

Trabajo en equipo

Orientación a crear capacidad sostenible, compartir conocimiento y generar una comunidad de profesionales alrededor de la ingeniería y arquitectura de datos.

Gestión económica

Solidez en la elaboración y seguimiento de presupuestos, estimaciones, márgenes, previsiones, asignaciones y planes de capacidad.

Iniciativa y proactividad

Capacidad para anticipar necesidades, identificar oportunidades y tomar decisiones en contextos complejos o con información incompleta.

Visión tecnológica y de negocio

Capacidad para valorar una solución no solo por su adecuación técnica, sino también por su viabilidad económica, escalabilidad, impacto y alineamiento con la estrategia del cliente.

Otros requisitos

Flexibilidad para trabajar con diferentes industrias, clientes y equipos.
Capacidad para desenvolverse en entornos de crecimiento, transformación y elevada exigencia.
Orientación a resultados, calidad y generación de impacto.

jobs.title: Integration Architect
jobs.description:
NTT DATA
es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría.

Digital Technology
es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica.

Digital Architecture
es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades.

En Digital Architecture estamos en búsqueda de profesionales con experiencia en arquitectura de integración
, capaces de diseñar soluciones que conecten aplicaciones, sistemas y servicios de forma segura, escalable y eficiente.

¿Qué esperamos encontrar?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que tuvieras:
Como mínimo 5 años de experiencia
en diseño, desarrollo y gestión de soluciones de integración entre sistemas, aplicaciones y plataformas.
Experiencia en definición de arquitecturas de integración
basadas en APIs, eventos, servicios, mensajería o modelos híbridos.
Conocimientos en especificaciones y estándares de integración
como OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, REST, SOAP, gRPC o equivalentes.
Experiencia con plataformas y herramientas de integración
como MuleSoft, Apigee, Kong, IBM API Connect, TIBCO, WebMethods, Kafka, RabbitMQ u otras tecnologías similares.
Conocimientos de seguridad en integración
, incluyendo OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, API Keys, certificados o mecanismos de autenticación y autorización entre sistemas.
Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia en plataformas cloud
como AWS, Azure o Google Cloud, así como en arquitecturas híbridas, microservicios, contenedores o despliegues cloud-native.
También se valorará la familiaridad con frameworks de desarrollo
como Spring Boot, NestJS, Express.js o equivalentes.

Más que el conocimiento de una única plataforma, buscamos criterio para diseñar el modelo de integración más adecuado
en cada contexto: APIs, eventos, mensajería, servicios o arquitecturas híbridas.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
Diseñar y definir arquitecturas de integración end-to-end alineadas con los objetivos de negocio, los sistemas existentes y la evolución tecnológica de cada cliente.
Seleccionar y aplicar patrones de integración basados en APIs, eventos, servicios, mensajería o modelos híbridos, según las necesidades del caso de uso.
Acompañar la implementación de integraciones entre aplicaciones, plataformas corporativas, canales digitales y servicios externos.
Garantizar la seguridad, escalabilidad, rendimiento, observabilidad y mantenibilidad de las soluciones implementadas.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, negocio, infraestructura y arquitectura para asegurar decisiones técnicas coherentes y entregas de calidad.
Definir estándares, modelos de gobierno y criterios de reutilización para APIs, eventos y activos de integración.
Aportar criterio técnico en la elección y evolución de herramientas, plataformas y patrones de integración.
Documentar arquitecturas, APIs, flujos y activos reutilizables mediante herramientas de diseño, gobierno y documentación técnica.

📍 Aunque nuestra búsqueda está centrada principalmente en Valladolid, también tenemos equipos en Barcelona, Madrid, Sevilla, Valencia y Zaragoza. Por lo que si vives en estas u otras ciudades también nos interesa tu perfil y estaremos encantados de conocerte.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
🧠 Formar parte de un equipo de élite especializado en la unión entre estrategia y tecnología.
💼 Contrato indefinido con revisiones de categoría y salario de manera anual.
🎓 Certificaciones bonificadas de los principales proveedores cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) y otras tecnologías.
📝 Acceso gratuito a nuestra plataforma formativa, NTT DATA University , donde encontrarás formaciones técnicas, metodológicas, idiomas y soft skills.
💻 Trabajo híbrido y horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación.
📅 Jornada intensiva (8:00 a 15:00) los viernes y los meses de verano.
🏥 Beneficios corporativos: complementos salariales adicionales, retribución flexible, seguro médico, seguro de vida y accidentes y muchos más.
🌊 Programas solidarios y actividades sociales para impulsar un impacto positivo a través de nuestro portal de voluntarios The Blue Wave .
🔝 Un ambiente de trabajo excelente, que fomenta el compañerismo y la buena convivencia. Somos Global Top Employer 2025, y, en España, por 10º año consecutivo.
🌏 Innovación diversa y cultura inclusiva. En NTT DATA creemos que cada persona es única y apostamos por una cultura que valora la diversidad y fomenta un entorno donde todos podamos explorar y potenciar nuestra singularidad.

¡Únete al equipo de Digital Technology en NTT DATA!

jobs.description:
Senior ServiceNow Developer/ Consultant

The opportunity

ServiceNow is a global tool used widely to manage business processes of Enterprise clients and our ServiceNow team is part of the global structure of EY as a Global Elite partner of ServiceNow. Involving different roles and stakeholders we provide our customers with the best consultancy and solutions.

As member of our team, based in the EY GDS Spain office in Málaga,
you would be a part of project teams involved in implementation, configuration and maintenance of NowPlatform allowing you to develop your technical and business skills in global environment. As Global Elite ServiceNow partner EY works with all types of modules of the platform, heavily using their features and developing custom solutions not yet built by others.

Your Key Responsibilities

As a Senior ServiceNow Developer, you will be tasked with directing the development and implementation of intricate business processes. This also involves the analysis of business requirements at all stages of development. You may have the opportunity to lead a team of consultants during projects or design the architecture of ServiceNow solutions.

Skills And Attributes For Success

To excel in this role, you must possess a comprehensive understanding of the platform and exhibit confidence when working through implementation, customization or maintenance projects. This may be demonstrated through:

Outstanding knowledge of NowPlatform architecture with at least 3 years of professional experience
Experience in product customizations, integrations, implementation or maintenance
Experience in project activities as a Developer

To qualify for the role, you must have

At least 3 years of ServiceNow implementation experience
Advanced ServiceNow CAD or CIS certification
Demonstrated experience with at least two programming languages (JavaScript, C#, Java or others)
Proven experience and advanced understanding of ITSM and HRSD
Showcased knowledge of Best Practices in Software Development
Thorough understanding of ITIL and Agile methodologies
Excellent communication skills in English (B2 – C1)

Ideally, you’ll also have

Spanish, German, French or other European languages would be an advantage but not mandatory
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a technical field or economic field

What We Look For

We are looking to hire a Senior ServiceNow Developer/ Consultant, who is passionate about creating innovative and bespoke solutions for our clients. We value individuals who wish to expand their product knowledge, work with global stakeholders across different workflows of product, and potentially progress to architect, tech lead, dev lead, or project management roles. If you are keen on initiating discussions and overseeing projects right up to post go-live activities - we are looking for you.

What We Offer

In EY GDS Spain, we’re committed to fostering a vibrant environment where every team member can thrive. We provide a space for continuous learning and the flexibility to define your own success, empowering you to make a meaningful impact in your own way. Our diverse and inclusive culture values who you are and encourages you to help others find their voice.

Additionally, here’s what makes us stand out:

Empowering Career Development: Unlock your potential with tailored training and development programs designed to elevate your skills and propel your career forward. We invest in your growth because your success is our success.
Flexible Work-Life Integration: Enjoy the freedom of our hybrid work model, allowing you to blend professional responsibilities with personal passions. We understand that life is more than just work, and we support you in achieving that balance.
Comprehensive Well-Being Programs: Prioritize your health with our extensive wellness initiatives, including psychological support sessions and health resources. At EY GDS Spain, your well-being is at the heart of what we do.
Meaningful Volunteering Opportunities: Make a difference in your community through our engaging volunteering programs. Join us in giving back and creating a positive impact while building connections with like-minded colleagues.
Recognized Performance and Rewards: Celebrate your achievements with our recognition programs that honor both individual and team successes. We believe in acknowledging hard work and dedication, ensuring you feel valued every step of the way.

Join us at EY GDS Spain, where your journey is supported, your contributions are celebrated, and your future is bright.

To learn more about what we offer, visit our

Careers in Global Delivery Services | EY - Global
page.

About EY GDS

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is the hub of innovation, a technology powerhouse, a global talent center and a driver of operational excellence within EY, propelling EY’s purpose of building a better working world. With a robust network spread across 8 countries and 21 cities, EY GDS’ dynamic network of highly talented professionals leverage data, AI, and leading-edge technology to enhance EY's wide array of services in Assurance, Consulting, Tax and EY-Parthenon.

By seamlessly integrating with EY member firms across the globe, EY GDS contributes significantly to EY's purposeful and sustainable growth, delivering insights and solutions that foster trust in capital markets and create value for EY clients, society, and the planet.

EY GDS is all in to shape the future with confidence, addressing today's challenges, and anticipating tomorrow's needs. EY GDS is not just reimagining the future of work—it's actively building it, ensuring agility, efficiency, and resilience in an ever-evolving world.

If you are interested in being part of our team, we kindly invite you to submit your CV in English to apply for this position.

jobs.description:
Estamos à procura de um Application Support Engineer sénior para integrar o polo de Production Engineering da divisão de Retail Application Support, no contexto das operações de Assurance-Vie e processamento de pagamentos.

Principais Responsabilidades

Suporte Operacional de Nível 3: Assegurar a estabilidade e resolução avançada de incidentes aplicacionais e de infraestrutura em ambientes críticos, identificando a causa-raiz (Problem Management) e participando na escala de prevenção (on-call 24/7 fora do horário laboral).
Industrialização e Automação: Conceber e implementar scripts de automação (Shell, Python) e ferramentas para simplificar tarefas operacionais, otimizar rotinas de suporte e garantir a uniformização dos ambientes.
Gestão de Mudanças e Entregas (Change & Release Management): Coordenar e executar a colocação em produção de novas versões aplicacionais (deployments) em estreita articulação com as equipas de desenvolvimento, sistemas, bases de dados e redes.
Monitorização e Cumprimento de SLAs: Definir métricas de desempenho, supervisionar plataformas de observabilidade e implementar sistemas eficazes de alerta (Zabbix, Grafana, ELK) para garantir o cumprimento estrito dos SLAs de negócio.
Continuidade de Negócio e Resiliência (DRP): Planear, executar e validar exercícios semestrais do Plano de Recuperação de Desastres (Disaster Recovery Plan), bem como assegurar a integridade dos processos de cópias de segurança (backups) e testes periódicos de restauro.
Gestão de Capacidade e Arquitetura: Avaliar a carga aplicacional, propondo o redimensionamento de recursos de infraestrutura ou redefinições de arquitetura para acomodar o crescimento dos volumes de transações.
Agendamento e Orquestração de Processos: Parametrizar, monitorizar e manter os fluxos de processamento em lote (batch processing) através de ferramentas de agendamento corporativas.
Documentação Técnica e Procedimental: Redigir e atualizar documentação de arquitetura técnica, matrizes de fluxo, manuais operacionais e procedimentos de resposta rápida a incidentes.

Requisitos mínimos

Experiência mínima comprovada de 6 anos em projetos de IT, engenharia de produção ou suporte aplicacional N3 em ecossistemas Linux.
Conhecimentos aprofundados de administração de ambientes Linux (Red Hat / CentOS / Debian).
Domínio na criação de scripts para automação de processos em Shell Scripting e Python.
Sólidos conhecimentos de servidores aplicacionais e web (experiência em gestão ou migração de servidores, e.g., JBoss / WildFly, WebSphere, Apache, Tomcat).
Domínio prático de protocolos e segurança de rede aplicacional: gestão de certificados digitais (SSL/TLS), funcionamento de reverse proxies e configurações de balanceamento de carga (Load Balancing).
Conhecimentos de ferramentas de agendamento/orquestração de tarefas em lote (ex.: Control-M, VTOM).
Prática com ferramentas de monitorização, análise de métricas e agregação de logs (ex.: Zabbix, Grafana, stack ELK).
Familiaridade com ferramentas de controlo de versões, integração contínua e ciclo de deployment (ex.: Git, Bitbucket, Jenkins, XL Deploy, XL Release, Artifactory, Docker, OpenShift).

Requisitos Operacionais e Idiomas

Fluência em Inglês (obrigatório, nível mínimo B2/C1 para trabalho diário em equipa internacional); conhecimentos de Francês são uma forte mais-valia.
Disponibilidade para integrar regimes de prevenção / piquete (on-call) fora do horário normal de expediente.

Conhecimentos de administração de ambientes Windows Server e scripts PowerShell.
Experiência prévia em ambientes financeiros, bancários, meios de pagamento ou seguros.

Elevado rigor, sentido de responsabilidade e capacidade de gestão sob pressão em ambientes de elevada criticidade.

jobs.title: Azure Platform Senior Consultant
jobs.description:
Avanade is the leading provider of innovative digital, cloud, and advisory services, business solutions, and design-led experiences across the Microsoft ecosystem. Every day, our 60,000+ professionals in 26 countries make a genuine human impact on our clients, their employees, and their customers.

We are currently expanding our Infrastructure Community in Portugal to drive a strategic, large-scale digital transformation project for a major player in the insurance sector. This project focuses on modernizing core life insurance systems, optimizing hybrid environments, and accelerating secure cloud adoption.

Role Purpose

As a Senior Infrastructure Consultant
, you will serve as a technical anchor and trusted advisor. You will design, build, and migrate enterprise-grade cloud environments using the Microsoft Azure ecosystem. You will ensure that the infrastructure supporting core insurance operations is secure, highly available, compliant with financial regulations, and fully automated.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Cloud Engineering

Design & Deploy: Create high-level and low-level designs (HLD/LLD) for scalable enterprise infrastructure on Microsoft Azure (IaaS and PaaS).
Hybrid Integration: Architect secure connectivity between on-premises datacenters and Azure cloud services using ExpressRoute, VPNs, and Azure Virtual WAN.
Core Modernization: Support the migration of legacy insurance applications and workloads to modern cloud native architectures.

Automation & DevOps

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Standardize environment provisioning using Terraform, Bicep, or ARM Templates to eliminate manual configuration drift.
CI/CD Pipelines: Collaborate with DevOps teams to integrate infrastructure deployments into Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions pipelines.
Scripting: Develop robust PowerShell or Azure CLI scripts to automate routine operations, compliance checks, and patching tasks.

Security, Compliance & Business Continuity

Identity & Access: Implement strict Zero Trust models using Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), RBAC, PIM, and Conditional Access policies.
Data Protection: Configure Azure Key Vault, disk encryption, and data-at-rest/in-transit protection to safeguard sensitive policyholder information.
Resilience: Design and test rigorous Disaster Recovery (DR) and Backup strategies utilizing Azure Backup and Azure Site Recovery (ASR) to meet strict insurance RTO/RPO metrics.

Consultative Leadership & Stakeholder Management

Trusted Advisor: Act as the main technical point of contact for the client’s IT leadership team, aligning infrastructure choices with business goals.
Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team members within the Avanade delivery unit.
Cost Optimization: Monitor cloud spends and resource utilization using Azure Advisor and Microsoft Cost Management to deliver FinOps recommendations.

Qualifications

Required Technical Skills

Experience: 5+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure engineering, with at least 3 years focused heavily on Microsoft Azure enterprise deployments.
Networking & Security: Deep understanding of Azure networking (VNet peering, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateways) and cloud security best practices.
Systems Administration: Strong background in Windows Server and/or Linux administration within enterprise environments.
Automation Mastery: Proven hands-on experience with Terraform or Bicep, along with PowerShell scripting.

Professional & Soft Skills

Industry Context: Experience working within regulated environments (Financial Services, Insurance, or Banking) is highly valued.
Consulting Mindset: Ability to articulate complex technical architectures to non-technical business stakeholders clearly.
Methodologies: Solid understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum/Kanban) and ITIL service management concepts.
Languages: Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory for internal collaboration. Professional proficiency in Portuguese is required for day-to-day client interaction.

Preferred Certifications

Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
Microsoft Certified: Azure Infrastructure Associate (AZ-104).
HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate.

What We Offer

Opportunity to work on a critical, high-visibility digital transformation project with a tangible impact on the Portuguese insurance market.
A dedicated training budget and clear pathways to achieve top-tier Microsoft certifications.
Flexible hybrid working model matching the project’s collaboration needs.
Competitive benefits package and a collaborative culture that values diversity and continuous learning.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

People Leadership & Delivery (30%)

Qualifications

Backend: 9+ years of solid experience in Java development (Spring Boot, Hibernate, microservices architecture).

Database & DevOps: Good understanding of relational/non-relational databases, CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions), and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is highly valued.

Language: Fluent/Native French (C1/C2) is mandatory, as you will interface directly with French clients/business units. Professional English proficiency is also required.

Communication: Outstanding interpersonal skills; ability to negotiate, influence, and translate complex technical jargon into business value for non-technical stakeholders.

We will only consider CVs in English.

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. In this role, you will work closely with senior developers and architects to build high-quality backend services, responsive web applications, and scalable cloud solutions. Familiarity with relational databases such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP fundamentals, and web services development.
Experience using Git and common source code management workflows.
Knowledge of software testing principles and experience writing unit tests.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Strong willingness to learn, take initiative, and grow within a development team.

Exposure to monitoring and observability tools.

Udvikle case management applikationer: processer og services, der understøtter konkrete forretningsprocesser.

Bygge robuste REST-API’er og arbejde med datahåndtering (fx via Hibernate/JPA eller direkte mod databaser).

har erfaring med softwareudvikling,

Company Description

Welcome to Kanadevia Inova,
a global innovation leader in the waste infrastructure space, where we believe in creating a sustainable future through technology and innovation.

Transforming Waste into Value

At Kanadevia Inova, we pride ourselves on being at the forefront of waste-to-X technology. We are not just waste managers; we are creators of value from what communities discard. Your role at Kanadevia Inova directly contributes to turning something once considered useless - waste - into something invaluable: energy, heat, hydrogen, fertilizer, and beyond..

Find out more about Kanadevia Inova at www.kanadevia-inova.com.

Job Description

Join our new Collaboration & Power Solutions Team
and play a key role in advancing our cloud-first strategy
and shaping a modern digital workplace
.

As a Power Solution Expert
, you will help business teams turn ideas into valuable Microsoft Power Platform solutions
. You will lead the development of secure, scalable applications and foster adoption by supporting citizen developers and delivering practical training such as App in a Day workshops.

Key Responsibilities

Enable citizen development: Coach business users to build small Power Platform solutions, support the maker community and deliver hands-on formats such as App in a Day workshops.
Lead complex solution delivery: Translate business needs into secure, scalable and maintainable applications, taking responsibility from solution design through testing and deployment.
Co-define Power Platform governance: Work with relevant teams to establish standards and guardrails and implement environment, security, data protection and application lifecycle controls.
Connect solutions across the digital workplace: Collaborate with internal teams to integrate Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365 services, enterprise data and other systems.
Keep solutions reliable and improving: Provide third-level expertise, maintain documentation and use platform insights to improve service quality and adoption

Qualifications

At least 3 years of experience in Power Platform development, solution architecture, and Microsoft 365 collaboration technologies within enterprise environments.
Strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse and governance best practices for scalable low-code solutions.
Solid knowledge of Microsoft 365 services such as Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Exchange Online, combined with a good understanding of security, governance, and Entra ID.
Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions, working closely with both business stakeholders and IT teams to deliver measurable value.
Professional English communication skills, with the confidence to facilitate discussions, provide guidance and collaborate effectively in an international environment.

new_jobs.title: SAP iXP Intern Developer in Cloud Lifecycle Engeneering
new_jobs.description:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

PURPOSE
AND OBJECTIVES

The Cloud Lifecycle Engeneering organization designs and implements the infrastructure to handle the requirements of the rapidly growing SAP Cloud Business. We are implementing the automation of delivering the whole portfolio of SAP Software to our customers, also we automate the process on update/upgrade and decommission of our software. We work with the latest cloud native technologies and we have solutions both in Cloud and on-Premise. We focus on and embrace AI enablement of our products and AI automation in our daily work.

EXPECTATIONS AND TASKS

Are you looking for job with focus on all modern cloud and AI-native technologies, and project with huge impact on the business?

Do you have background in cloud or UI development? Are you eager to learn new technologies? Do you want to work with the latest cloud technologies in the world?

We are seeking experienced and highly motivated students. You will be part of the teams working on the core lifecycle management components for SAP’s cloud business. Our team is fully responsible for the automation, orchestration and scalability of various lifecycle management operations. Our customers are among the biggest and successful companies in the world. You will get the opportunity to work with most trending technologies, in a highly motivated team, established from young talents as well as experienced professionals.

Specifically, You Will

Design, develop, test and deliver platform features
Embrace the exciting opportunity to join a high-profile strategic and transformational project to deliver the next generation of software lifecycle management services
Participating in all phases of the software services development, from design discussions, implementation, testing, to deployment and operations
Work in an agile team applying Scrum, agile development practices and DevOps, thus contributing to team goals, requiring the flexibility and the ability to work on different topics.

Skills And Competencies

Required skills

▪ Student in Computer Science or related field

▪ Good knowledge in at least one OOP language, preferably Java

▪ Excellent theoretical and practical background in OOP, data structures, design patterns, algorithms

▪ Diverse coding skills, preferably with Java or UI frameworks

▪ Experience with Linux/UNIX

▪ Easily adapting to change and learning quickly in a fast-paced environment

▪ Excellent team player, self-motivated, passionate about technology

▪ Excellent verbal and written communication skills

▪ Fluency in English

Advantage

▪ Experience in AI-native software development

▪ Experience with Kubernetes or Cloud Foundry

▪ Experience with various cloud services in AWS, GCP and Azure

▪ Use and knowledge of common build tools, repositories and CD/CI tooling, experience in test automation

▪ Knowledge and experience with micro-service architectures

▪ Knowledge and experience with agile methodologies for software and service development

Work Experience

▪ Previous employment is not mandatory but certain practical experience is important

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.
